blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Frontier artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly operating over longer horizons with diminishing human oversight, raising the risk of loss of control: systems acting beyond effective human control with potentially irreversible consequences. Because such failures may become observable only after containment is difficult, they must be assessed prospectively. We introduce a behavioural framework that decomposes loss-of-control risk into three factors: misaligned motive, harm-enabling capability, and monitoring evasion. We operationalise these factors through 13 measurable aspects and 29 evaluation tasks, whose scores are combined into a single loss-of-control (LoC) score. Across 13 frontier models, the LoC score shows strong prospective validity, correlating with failure rates in contained long-horizon risk scenarios (Pearson r = 0.84). Risk varies systematically across models and cannot be explained by capability alone. We further show that the framework can guide targeted mitigations: fine-tuning and monitoring directed at diagnosed vulnerabilities reduce failure rates while largely preserving general performance. These results provide a practical basis for predicting, understanding, and mitigating loss-of-control risk before it materialises.
blocks.zh: 边疆人工智能系统越来越多地在更长的视野内运行,人类监督不断减少,增加了失去控制的风险:系统的行为超出了人类的有效控制,可能产生不可逆转的后果。 由于这种失败只有在难以遏制之后才能被观察到,因此必须对之进行前瞻性评估。 我们引入了一个行为框架,将失控风险分解为三个因素:动机错配、伤害能力和监测逃逸。 我们通过13个可衡量方面和29项评价任务将这些因素付诸实施,这些评价任务的分数合并为一个控制丧失分数。 在13个前沿模型中,LoC得分显示出强烈的预期有效性,与包含的长视距风险假设(Pearson r = 0.84)中的故障率有关. 不同模式的风险有系统变化,不能仅以能力来解释。 我们进一步表明,该框架可以指导有针对性的缓解:针对确诊脆弱性的微调和监测可降低故障率,同时在很大程度上保持总体绩效。 这些结果为预测、理解和减轻控制损失风险提供了实际依据,然后才实现。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Frontier artificial intelligence (AI) is shifting from passive content generation towards autonomous agents [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Driven by large language models (LLMs), these systems can plan, utilise tools, and interact with external environments [ 4 , 5 ] , enabling them to pursue long-horizon objectives with limited human oversight [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] . This increasing autonomy introduces the risk of loss of control, a scenario in which AI systems operate outside effective human or automated control, and regaining control is highly difficult or impossible [ 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] . This risk moves beyond ordinary technical failures or misuse [ 13 , 14 ] , potentially leading to catastrophic and existential consequences [ 15 , 16 ] . Long a classic trope of science fiction, this phenomenon has now emerged as a concrete scientific challenge as these systems are increasingly embedded in the critical infrastructure of modern society [ 17 ] . This concern is increasingly reflected in governance, where measuring and mitigating loss of control has been an explicit component of major policy frameworks such as the EU AI Act [ 18 ] , California’s SB-53 [ 19 ] , and China’s Artificial Intelligence Safety Governance Framework 2.0 [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 边疆人工智能(AI)从被动内容生成转向自主代理[1,2,3]. 在大型语言模型(LLMs)的推动下,这些系统可以规划、使用工具,并与外部环境[4,5]互动,使它们能够在有限的人监督下追求长远目标[6,7,8]. 这种日益增强的自主性带来了失去控制的风险,这种局面是AI系统在有效人力或自动化控制之外运作,重新获得控制非常困难或不可能[9、10、11、12]。 这种风险超越了普通技术故障或滥用[13、14],有可能导致灾难性和活生生的后果[15、16]。 长期以来,这种现象是科幻小说的一个经典曲折,现在已成为一个具体的科学挑战,因为这些系统日益嵌入现代社会的关键基础设施[17]. 这种担忧在治理中日益得到体现,在治理中,衡量和缓解失控一直是欧盟AI法案[18],加利福尼亚州SB-53 [19],中国人工智能安全治理框架2.0 [20]等主要政策框架的一个明确组成部分.

blocks.en: Despite its importance, studying loss of control presents an inherent methodological challenge, because the phenomenon is fully observable only post hoc, after an AI system could no longer be reliably contained or shut down [ 21 ] . At that point, attempts to restore control may be infeasible or too late to prevent irreversible harm [ 22 , 23 ] . Such a challenge creates a fundamental asymmetry between observation and intervention: by the time loss of control becomes empirically evident, the window for effective prevention may already have closed. This highlights the significance of prospective analysis, whose central objective is to forecast loss-of-control risk before it materialises and to identify the mechanisms that make such failures more likely.
blocks.zh: 研究失去控制问题尽管很重要,但它在方法上必然是一项挑战,因为这一现象只有在AI系统不再能够可靠地被控制或关闭之后,才能在事后充分观察到。 此时,恢复控制的努力可能不可行或为时已晚,无法防止不可逆转的损害[22、23]。 这种挑战造成观察和干预之间的根本不对称:当失去控制成为实证时,有效预防的窗口可能已经关闭了。 这突出说明了预期分析的重要性,其中心目标是在控制损失风险发生之前对其进行预测并查明使这种失败更有可能发生的机制。

blocks.en:
Recent studies have identified behaviours that may constitute precursors to loss of control.
For example, Apollo Research found that several frontier models can engage in in-context scheming [ 24 ] . When placed in agentic environments that incentivise misaligned behaviours, they recognise opportunities for deception, pursue self-preserving strategies, attempt to circumvent oversight, and even seek to exfiltrate their weights, while often maintaining these deceptive strategies under subsequent interrogations. Anthropic showed that Claude Opus 4 can engage in deliberate harmful behaviours [ 25 ] such as blackmail and corporate espionage when their assigned goals conflict with their deploying company’s strategic direction, even after explicitly acknowledging the ethical violations involved. Other studies have identified similar warning signs, including sabotaging human control [ 26 , 27 ] , underperforming on evaluations to conceal capabilities [ 28 , 29 ] , and engaging in strategic deception [ 30 ] , further indicating the risk of loss of control. Yet, these control-undermining behaviours are mostly studied either as individual observations in specific scenarios [ 31 , 32 , 33 ] or as separate components of potential loss of control [ 34 , 35 , 36 , 37 ] . Existing studies, therefore, leave unresolved what combination of behavioural properties would make such warning signs indicative of an AI system approaching loss-of-control, rather than isolated failures in particular test settings. Addressing this gap requires a predictive framework that combines contained simulations of plausible failure conditions with systematic measurements of precursor capabilities, causal drivers and intervention efficacy before deployment.
blocks.zh:
最近的研究查明了可能构成丧失管制的先兆的行为。
例如,"阿波罗研究"发现有几种前沿模型可以进行编译计划[24]. 当他们被置于诱发错位行为的代理环境中时,他们就会认识到欺骗的机会,追求自我保全策略,试图规避监督,甚至试图揭开他们的分量,同时经常在以后的审讯中保持这些欺骗策略. Anthropic 显示克洛德·奥普斯4可以从事蓄意的有害行为[25],例如敲诈和公司间谍,当其指定的目标与其部署公司的战略方向相冲突时,甚至在明确承认所涉违反道德行为之后。 其他研究也发现了类似的警示信号,包括破坏人类控制[26,27],在评价中表现不佳以隐藏能力[28,29],并进行战略欺骗[30],进一步表明失去控制的风险. 然而,这些破坏控制的行为大多作为特定情景中的个人观察[31、32、33]或作为潜在丧失控制的不同组成部分加以研究[34、35、36、37]。 因此,现有的研究没有解决行为属性的组合是什么使得这种警告信号表明AI系统接近失控,而不是在特定测试环境中孤立的失败。 解决这一差距需要有一个预测性框架,其中包含对可能失败条件的模拟,并系统地测量前体能力、因果驱动因素和部署前的干预效力。

blocks.en:
To this end, we establish such a predictive framework informed by the behavioural science.
While AI systems are not human actors, we argue that loss of control can be productively analysed through the lens of human behaviour by focusing on the structural parallels with the conditions that give rise to harmful human conduct. This perspective is inspired by psychological and criminological theories, which explain harmful conduct not by a single cause, but by the conjunction of motivation, capability and weak control [ 38 , 39 ] . A similar philosophy also appears in concurrent frontier-risk reports from METR and Anthropic [ 40 , 41 ] , which frame such risks around the joint presence of means, motive, and opportunity. Beyond the conceptual framing in these reports, we operationalise this philosophy as a measurable framework with three factors: misaligned motive, the pursuit of objectives that diverge from human intent; harm-enabling capability, the capacity to execute actions required to realise those objectives; and monitoring evasion, the ability to continue such actions despite external monitoring and intervention. By evaluating observable behaviours corresponding to these factors, the framework assesses the extent to which a frontier AI system satisfies the conditions for loss of control and identifies the factors that drive this risk.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们建立了基于行为科学的这种预测框架。
虽然人工智能系统不是人类行为者,但我们认为,可以通过人类行为的视角,通过注重与导致有害人类行为的条件的结构相平行,对失去控制的情况进行富有成效的分析。 这种观点受到心理和犯罪学理论的启发,这些理论解释有害行为的原因不是单一原因,而是动机、能力和控制薄弱的结合[38、39]。 METR和Anthropic[40,41]同时提交的边界风险报告也出现了类似的理念,报告围绕共同存在手段、动机和机会规定了这种风险。 除了这些报告中的概念框架外,我们还将这一理念作为具有三个因素的可衡量框架加以实施:动机错位、追求与人类意图不同的目标、有利伤害的能力、执行实现这些目标所必须的行动的能力、以及监测逃避行为、不顾外部监测和干预而继续这种行动的能力。 通过评估与这些因素相适应的可观察到的行为,该框架评估了前沿AI系统满足丧失控制条件的程度,并确定了导致这种风险的因素。

blocks.en:
The framework is inherently general and allows concrete measurements to evolve with the frontier AI capabilities.
In this work, we instantiate the three factors using observable behaviours in current AI systems. These behaviours span motives that diverge from human intent under goal conflict, including self-preservation and power-seeking; operational capabilities that enable autonomous, cyber, or CBRN-relevant actions; and control-sensitive ones, such as situational awareness, sandbagging, and deception, through which external control may be weakened.
As illustrated in Fig. 1 a, we decompose the three factors into 13 fine-grained aspects, which serve as structured indicators rather than isolated warning signs.
These aspects are evaluated using 29 tasks, primarily drawn from established benchmarks and supplemented with custom evaluations where existing benchmarks are insufficient. The resulting factor-level scores are combined multiplicatively into an overall loss-of-control (LoC) score that measures proximity to the conditions under which loss of control could emerge.
blocks.zh:
该框架本质上是一般性的,可以随着前沿AI能力而发展出具体的测量。
在这项工作中,我们利用当前人工智能系统中的可观察行为,即时分析这三个因素。 这些行为的动机与目标冲突下的人类意图不同,包括自我保护和寻求权力;能够采取自主、网络或化学、生物、辐射和核相关行动的行动能力;以及具有控制敏感性的行动,例如情况意识、打沙和欺骗,通过这些行动,外部控制可能会被削弱。
如图1a所示,我们把三个因素分为13个精细的方面,它们只是结构化的指标,而不是孤立的警告信号。
这些方面的评价采用29项任务,主要取自既定基准,并辅之以现有基准不足的定制评价。 由此产生的因数等级分数被乘以总的失控分数(LOC),以衡量是否接近可能出现失控的情况。

blocks.en: We next validate whether the framework can provide an ex ante measure of loss-of-control risk. To this end, we conduct a proof-of-concept study that simulates long-horizon loss-of-control risks in contained environments. The evaluation suite spans four representative frontier-risk domains: autonomous misevolution, malicious competition, covert scheming and cooperative subversion. Each domain contains five risk scenarios, each defined by combining one aspect from each of the three factors, and each scenario contains 20 test cases, yielding 400 test cases in total. The LoC scores derived from the selected aspects are then compared with observed failure rates on the test cases. As shown in Fig. 1 b and Fig. 2 , LoC scores are positively correlated with failure rates for different models. We observe a correlation coefficient of 0.84 between the overall LoC scores and the average failure rates across models. In a more fine-grained analysis, this positive correlation holds even across different models and risk scenarios, with an overall coefficient of 0.57, suggesting that the framework can translate behavioural observations into a predictive measure of loss-of-control risk.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来要确认,该框架是否能够预先衡量失控风险。 为此,我们进行概念证明研究,模拟在所控制环境中长期失去控制的风险。 评估套装跨越四个具有代表性的前沿风险领域:自主错误演化、恶意竞争、隐蔽阴谋和合作颠覆。 每个领域包含5个风险假设,每个风险假设由三个因素中每个因素的一个方面合并而来定义,每个假设包含20个测试案例,总共产生400个测试案例. 然后将选定方面的LoC分数同测试案例的观测出故障率进行比较。 如图一b和图一. 2, LoC分数与不同模型的故障率正相关. 我们观测到,在总的LoC分数和各种模型的平均失败率之间,相关系数为0.84。 在更细致的分析中,这种正相关甚至存在于不同的模型和风险假设中,总体系数为0.57,表明框架可将行为观察转化为对失控风险的预测性衡量。

blocks.en: Supported by this validation, we further conduct a systematic assessment of the risk-relevant conditions to understand loss of control in existing models. Our evaluation of 13 frontier LLMs shows that the risk depends not only on their capabilities but also on whether divergent objectives can be translated into realistic outcomes through operational capabilities and weakened control. For example, despite the similar performance in capabilities, GPT-5.2 exhibits comparatively low downstream failure rates, whereas Gemini 3 Pro is more prone to loss of control. The difference in monitor evasion reshapes the pathway from capability to control failure. Beyond this, the risk is also affected by the reasoning capability. As evidenced by the elevated tendency in Qwen thinking-enabled variants, we find that though enhanced reasoning yields capability gains, it amplifies the misaligned motives simultaneously. Furthermore, this framework not only helps understand and prospectively track failures in risk scenarios but also sheds light on the risk mitigation. With supervised fine-tuning and monitoring focusing on the identified weaknesses, we can better reduce failure rates while preserving general utility. More broadly, these results recast studying loss of control from a remedial action of catastrophic failure into a predictive science of risk-relevant conditions. By identifying the factors that drive loss of control, estimating the proximity to critical boundaries, and locating points for intervention, the behavioural framework provides a basis for continuous governance before loss of control becomes unrecoverable.
blocks.zh: 在本次验证的支持下,我们进一步对风险相关条件进行系统评估,以了解现有模型中失控的情况。 我们对13个边疆有限责任公司的评价表明,这种风险不仅取决于它们的能力,还取决于是否能够通过行动能力和削弱控制将不同的目标转化为现实的结果。 例如,尽管能力性能相似,GPT-5.2显示下游故障率相对较低,而双子座3 Pro则更容易失去控制. 监测逃逸的差异改变了从能力到控制失败的路径。 除此之外,风险还受推理能力的影响。 正如Quen思维驱动的变体的上升趋势所证明的那样,我们发现,虽然增强推理会提高能力,但它会同时扩大错误的动机。 此外,这一框架不仅有助于了解和预测风险假设的失败,而且有助于阐明风险缓解。 通过对已查明的弱点进行监督的微调和监测,我们可以更好地降低故障率,同时保持总体效用。 更广泛地说,这些结果将研究从灾难性失败的补救行动到风险相关情况的预测科学的丧失控制情况。 通过确定造成失去控制的因素,估计离关键边界的相近程度并找到干预点,行为框架为在失去控制无法恢复之前持续治理提供了基础。

blocks.en: Table 1: Overview of 13 LLMs evaluated in this study. Models are organized into three groups: selected Qwen variants, open-source frontier LLMs, and proprietary frontier LLMs. The Qwen variants enable controlled comparison across model scales, architectures, and thinking modes. The open-source and proprietary groups comprise diverse frontier LLMs to ensure comprehensive coverage. For each model, we report total parameters, active parameters for mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, thinking mode, and provider. blocks.zh: 2 结果

blocks.en: 2.1 Behavioural Framework for Factorizing Loss of Control
blocks.zh: 2.1 将丧失控制因素化的行为框架

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the behavioural framework. a , The framework decomposes loss of control into three factors: misaligned motive, harm-enabling capability, and monitoring evasion, which are evaluated separately and yield an overall LoC score. b , Factor-level scores and LoC scores across 13 frontier LLMs and 3 non-thinking variants. Error bars are for standard deviations. The LoC score reliably predicts a model’s overall propensity for loss-of-control, correlating strongly with its failure rate averaged across risk scenarios (Pearson’s r = 0.84 r=0.84 ). c , Predictive validity of LoC scores against failure rates on risk scenarios across four frontier-risk domains. d , Mitigation strategies targeting the vulnerabilities diagnosed by the framework: supervised fine-tuning for misaligned motive and external monitoring for monitoring evasion.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 1 a, informed by the multi-factor perspectives in behavioural and criminological theories of harmful behaviour [ 38 , 39 ] , we propose a behavioural framework that decomposes the loss-of-control risk into three factors: misaligned motive, harm-enabling capability, and monitoring evasion. These factors characterise whether a model pursues objectives that diverge from human intent, can execute the actions needed to realise the objectives, and can sustain such behaviour despite external controls. Against the current landscape of control-undermining behaviours in frontier AI systems, we instantiate this framework by resolving the three factors into a fine-grained taxonomy of 13 aspects as follows:
blocks.zh: 如图1a所示,根据有害行为行为理论和犯罪学理论的多因素观点[38、39],我们提出了一个行为框架,将失控风险分解为三个因素:动机错配、伤害能力和监测逃逸。 这些因素说明,一个模式是否追求与人类意图不同的目标,是否能够采取实现目标所需的行动,以及能否不顾外部控制维持这种行为。 在目前控制破坏边境人工智能系统行为的情况下,我们通过将三个因素分为以下13个精细的分类,将这一框架即时化:

blocks.en: • Misaligned motive ( M M ) captures whether a system pursues objectives that deviate from human intent. Informed by both anticipated failure modes and behaviours already observed in LLMs [ 42 , 37 , 35 , 34 , 33 , 17 ] , we distinguish five distinct forms of objective divergence. Curiosity denotes the drive of exploration beyond the assigned task or authorised scope. Self-preservation captures a model’s inclination to protect its own continuity for the successful completion of its objective, while Power-seeking involves active efforts by an AI system to acquire and maintain power in ways unintended by its designers, arising as an instrumental sub-goal that the system adopts to better achieve its assigned objective. Pro-AI bias describes the models favouring AI-related interests over human interests. Sycophancy refers to the phenomenon where a model seeks human approval in unwanted ways even when it conflicts with truthfulness or safety. Together, these aspects aim to include representative sources from which a model’s genuine objectives may diverge from human intent. • Harm-enabling capability ( C C ) measures whether a system has the competence to execute misaligned objectives into consequential actions. We select aspects by focusing on domains consistently identified in major frontier AI governance frameworks as direct practice to increase the risk of severe harm [ 43 , 44 , 45 ] . These are Autonomy , covering sustained goal-directed action without human intervention; Cyber Capability , covering capabilities to facilitate cyberattacks and exploit network vulnerabilities; and CBRN Threats , covering capabilities relevant to chemical, biological, and radiological or nuclear harm. Overall, these aspects define whether a system is able to act autonomously to produce severe real-world consequences, rather than through deliberate human misuse. • Monitoring evasion ( E E ) reflects whether a system can persist with misaligned objectives despite monitoring. Given that online monitoring system designs remain rudimentary and difficult to scale [ 46 ] , we adopt offline monitoring as a more controlled setting. Here, the monitor audits each completed agent trajectory, and if it fails to detect misbehaviours, such failures will be treated as evidence of monitoring evasion and a proxy for escaping control [ 47 , 48 ] . We define this around five aspects, derived from three ways in which monitoring could fail: the system may perceive the deployed context it is in, manipulate what monitors observe, and directly undermine the mechanisms meant to control it. Accordingly, we distinguish Situational Awareness , which involves perceiving the deployed context; Sandbagging , Deception , and Persuasion , which reflect the strategic concealment of capabilities or linguistic manipulation; and Sabotage , which refers to directly interfering with control mechanisms, with a greater focus on control itself. Collectively, these aspects describe the progression from passive recognition of monitoring to active circumvention.
blocks.zh: • 不良动机(MM)掌握一个系统是否追求偏离人类意图的目标。 我们既了解预期的失败模式,也了解LLMS[42、37、35、34、33、17]中已经观察到的行为,我们区分了五种不同的客观差异形式。 好奇意指超出指定任务或授权范围的勘探活动。 自我保护捕捉到一个模型的倾向,即保护其自身的连续性以成功实现其目标,而寻求权力则涉及AI系统积极努力以设计者无意的方式获得并保持权力,这是该系统为更好地实现其指定目标而采用的一个工具性次级目标。 支持大赦国际的偏见描述了有利于大赦国际利益而不是人类利益的模式。 共性(Sycophancy)是指一个模型即使与真实性或安全性相冲突,也以不想要的方式寻求人类认可的现象. 这些方面加在一起,旨在包括一个模型的真正目标可能偏离人类意图的代表性来源。 • 有害能力(CC)衡量一个系统是否有权将目标错误地付诸行动。 我们通过侧重于主要前沿AI治理框架一致确定为增加严重伤害风险的直接做法的领域来选择各个方面[43、44、45]。 它们是自主性,涵盖在不进行人类干预的情况下针对目标采取的持久行动;网络能力,涵盖促进网络攻击和利用网络脆弱性的能力;化学、生物、辐射或核等威胁,涵盖与化学、生物、辐射或核损害有关的能力。 总体而言,这些方面决定了一个系统是否能够自主地采取行动,产生严重的现实世界后果,而不是故意滥用人类。 • 监测逃逸(英、法、俄、西)反映,尽管进行了监测,一个系统是否仍可维持目标不一致。 鉴于在线监测系统的设计仍很简陋,难以扩大[46],我们采用离线监测作为更受控制的环境。 在此,监测员对每个已完成的代理轨迹进行审计,如果未能发现不当行为,这种失败将被视为监测逃避的证据和逃避管制的代理[47、48]。 我们围绕五个方面来界定这一点,这些方面源于监测可能失败的三种方式:系统可能认识到它所部署的背景,操纵监测员所观察到的,并直接破坏旨在控制它的机制。 因此,我们区分了涉及了解部署背景的情况意识、反映战略隐藏能力或语言操纵的沙巴格、欺骗和劝诫;以及直接干扰控制机制的破坏,更加注重控制本身。 这些方面共同描述了从被动承认监测到主动规避的过程。

blocks.en: Misaligned motive ( M M ) captures whether a system pursues objectives that deviate from human intent. Informed by both anticipated failure modes and behaviours already observed in LLMs [ 42 , 37 , 35 , 34 , 33 , 17 ] , we distinguish five distinct forms of objective divergence. Curiosity denotes the drive of exploration beyond the assigned task or authorised scope. Self-preservation captures a model’s inclination to protect its own continuity for the successful completion of its objective, while Power-seeking involves active efforts by an AI system to acquire and maintain power in ways unintended by its designers, arising as an instrumental sub-goal that the system adopts to better achieve its assigned objective. Pro-AI bias describes the models favouring AI-related interests over human interests. Sycophancy refers to the phenomenon where a model seeks human approval in unwanted ways even when it conflicts with truthfulness or safety. Together, these aspects aim to include representative sources from which a model’s genuine objectives may diverge from human intent.
blocks.zh: 错位动机(MM)捕捉系统是否追求偏离人类意图的目标. 我们既了解预期的失败模式,也了解LLMS[42、37、35、34、33、17]中已经观察到的行为,我们区分了五种不同的客观差异形式。 好奇意指超出指定任务或授权范围的勘探活动。 自我保护捕捉到一个模型的倾向,即保护其自身的连续性以成功实现其目标,而寻求权力则涉及AI系统积极努力以设计者无意的方式获得并保持权力,这是该系统为更好地实现其指定目标而采用的一个工具性次级目标。 支持大赦国际的偏见描述了有利于大赦国际利益而不是人类利益的模式。 共性(Sycophancy)是指一个模型即使与真实性或安全性相冲突,也以不想要的方式寻求人类认可的现象. 这些方面加在一起,旨在包括一个模型的真正目标可能偏离人类意图的代表性来源。

blocks.en: Harm-enabling capability ( C C ) measures whether a system has the competence to execute misaligned objectives into consequential actions. We select aspects by focusing on domains consistently identified in major frontier AI governance frameworks as direct practice to increase the risk of severe harm [ 43 , 44 , 45 ] . These are Autonomy , covering sustained goal-directed action without human intervention; Cyber Capability , covering capabilities to facilitate cyberattacks and exploit network vulnerabilities; and CBRN Threats , covering capabilities relevant to chemical, biological, and radiological or nuclear harm. Overall, these aspects define whether a system is able to act autonomously to produce severe real-world consequences, rather than through deliberate human misuse.
blocks.zh: 有害能力(CC)衡量一个系统是否有权将目标错误地付诸行动。 我们通过侧重于主要前沿AI治理框架一致确定为增加严重伤害风险的直接做法的领域来选择各个方面[43、44、45]。 这些威胁包括:自主性,涵盖持续的目标导向行动,而无需人类干预;网络能力,涵盖促进网络攻击和利用网络脆弱性的能力;化学、生物、辐射或核损害相关能力。 总体而言,这些方面决定了一个系统是否能够自主地采取行动,产生严重的现实世界后果,而不是故意滥用人类。

blocks.en: Monitoring evasion ( E E ) reflects whether a system can persist with misaligned objectives despite monitoring. Given that online monitoring system designs remain rudimentary and difficult to scale [ 46 ] , we adopt offline monitoring as a more controlled setting. Here, the monitor audits each completed agent trajectory, and if it fails to detect misbehaviours, such failures will be treated as evidence of monitoring evasion and a proxy for escaping control [ 47 , 48 ] . We define this around five aspects, derived from three ways in which monitoring could fail: the system may perceive the deployed context it is in, manipulate what monitors observe, and directly undermine the mechanisms meant to control it. Accordingly, we distinguish Situational Awareness , which involves perceiving the deployed context; Sandbagging , Deception , and Persuasion , which reflect the strategic concealment of capabilities or linguistic manipulation; and Sabotage , which refers to directly interfering with control mechanisms, with a greater focus on control itself. Collectively, these aspects describe the progression from passive recognition of monitoring to active circumvention.
blocks.zh: 监测逃逸(英語:E E )反映了一个系统尽管受到监测,是否仍能坚持目标不协调。 鉴于在线监测系统的设计仍很简陋,难以扩大[46],我们采用离线监测作为更受控制的环境。 在此,监测员对每个已完成的代理轨迹进行审计,如果未能发现不当行为,这种失败将被视为监测逃避的证据和逃避管制的代理[47、48]。 我们围绕五个方面来界定这一点,这些方面源于监测可能失败的三种方式:系统可能认识到它所部署的背景,操纵监测员所观察到的,并直接破坏旨在控制它的机制。 因此,我们区分了涉及了解部署背景的情况意识、反映战略隐藏能力或语言操纵的沙巴格、欺骗和劝诫;以及直接干扰控制机制的破坏,更加注重控制本身。 这些方面共同描述了从被动承认监测到主动规避的过程。

blocks.en: To make this taxonomy measurable, we implement the 13 aspects through 29 evaluation tasks, combining existing benchmarks with newly designed tasks for behaviours that are not yet covered (see Methods, Sec . 4 ). Task scores are aggregated into aspect- and factor-level scores, and the three factor scores are multiplied together to obtain an overall loss-of-control (LoC) score as in Eq. ( 2 ). This multiplicative form reflects the joint requirement for loss of control, with risk elevated only when misaligned motives, operational capabilities and weakened control coincide. Moreover, when applied to a concrete risk scenario, the factor-level components of the LoC score could be specified by the aspects that define the scenario rather than being averaged across all. The resulting scores provide the basis for comparing frontier AI systems by the extent to which they satisfy the conditions for loss of control and diagnosing which components contribute most to the risk.
blocks.zh: 为了使这一分类可以衡量,我们通过29项评价任务执行了13个方面,将现有基准与尚未涵盖的行为新设计的任务结合起来(见《方法》,第4节)。 任务分数被归为一等分和一等分,而三个因子分数被相乘以获得总的"失控分(LOC)"分数,如Eq. (2.). 这种多变形式反映了失去控制的共同要求,只有在动机、行动能力和控制被削弱时,风险才会增加。 此外,如果适用于具体的风险假设,则 LoC 分数的系数级组成部分可以由确定假设的方方面面加以规定,而不是在所有方方面面加以平均。 由此得出的分数为比较前沿AI系统提供了依据,按其满足丧失控制条件的程度加以比较,并诊断哪些部分构成风险最大。

blocks.en: 2.2 Predictive Validity of the LoC Score
blocks.zh: 2.2  LoC 分数的预测有效性

blocks.en: A prospective measure of loss-of-control risk is useful only if it predicts failures before they occur. We therefore conduct a proof-of-concept study to test whether the LoC score can predict loss-of-control risk before it materialises. Because realised loss of control cannot be safely observed, we design risk scenarios under contained environments to simulate plausible loss-of-control failures. In these scenarios, models autonomously pursue misaligned objectives while strategically attempting to evade monitoring.
blocks.zh: 对失控风险的预期衡量只有在发生失败之前预测失败才有用。 因此,我们进行概念证明研究,以测试LoC分数是否能够在实际发生之前预测失控风险. 由于无法安全地观察到已实现的控制丧失,我们设计了在受控制环境中的风险假设情景来模拟可能发生的控制丧失故障。 在这些假想中,模型在战略上试图逃避监测的同时,自主追求错位目标.

blocks.en:
To make the scenarios informative for validation, we expect them to cover distinct failure modes through which precursor behaviours could develop into loss-of-control risk. Thus, we organize the risk scenarios around four frontier-risk domains drawn from canonical loss-of-control precursors [ 32 , 24 , 49 , 33 ] : Autonomous Misevolution , which captures self-directed evolution of a model’s capabilities away from authorized boundaries; Malicious Competition , which captures attempts to undermine coexisting agents to gain an advantage over them; Covert Scheming , which captures pursuit of hidden secondary objectives behind apparently compliant outputs; and Cooperative Subversion , which captures coordination among multiple AI systems to bypass constraints that none could easily overcome alone.
These domains span individual, competitive, covert and multi-agent risks through which early risk-relevant conditions could give rise to loss-of-control failures.
Within each domain, we design five scenarios and further instantiate each scenario with 20 cases, producing 400 test cases in total. Each scenario combines one specific aspect from each factor, defining a concrete risk pathway with an internal motive, task-relevant capabilities, and attempts to evade monitoring. The 20 cases of each scenario vary only in surface details like the task context while preserving the same underlying risk pathway. The monitor is implemented with GPT-4.1 in a weak-to-strong oversight setting [ 46 ] , and a case is counted as a failure only when the agent completes the scenario-specific risky objective and evades the monitor. Fig. 3 shows the representative failure cases in each domain.
We then pair the failure rate for each model and scenario with the corresponding LoC score. With 13 models and five scenarios in each domain, this yields 65 model-scenario data points per risk domain for correlation analysis (Fig. 2 a-d).
blocks.zh:
为了使这些假想能够提供信息以供验证,我们期望这些假想能够涵盖不同的失败模式,通过这些模式,前体行为可发展为失控风险。 因此,我们围绕四个前沿风险领域来安排风险设想,这些风险领域取自犬类管制前体损失[32、24、49、33]: 自主的Miservolution ,它捕捉一个模型的能力在授权边界之外自我引导的演化; 恶意的竞争,它捕捉破坏共存的代理人以获得优势的企图; 隐蔽的阴谋,它捕捉了在明显符合要求的产出背后隐藏的次级目标的追求; 合作的Subversion,它捕捉多个AI系统之间的协调,以绕过没有人能够轻易克服的限制.
这些领域涉及个人、竞争性、隐蔽和多代理风险,通过这些风险,与风险有关的早期条件可能导致失控的失败。
在每个领域,我们设计了五个假想方案,并用20个病例进一步即时分析每个假想方案,总共产生400个测试病例. 每种情况都结合了每个因素的一个具体方面,界定了具有内部动机的具体风险路径、与任务相关的能力和逃避监测的企图。 每种情景的20个案例仅在诸如任务背景的表面细节上有所不同,同时保留同样的基本风险路径。 监控器在弱到强的监督环境[46]下与GPT-4.1一起执行,只有在代理完成特定情景风险目标并逃避监控时,一个案例才算作故障. 图3显示了每个领域的代表性故障案例。
然后我们把每个模型和情景的故障率与相应的LoC分数相配. 每个领域有13个模型和5个假设情景,因此每个风险领域得出65个模型-情景数据点进行关联性分析(图2 a-d).

blocks.en: Figure 2: Predictive validity of LoC scores against empirical failure rates in risk scenarios across four frontier-risk domains. a , Pearson correlation between LoC scores and observed failure rates across scenarios in the risk domain of Autonomous misevolution . b , Pearson correlation between LoC scores and observed failure rates across scenarios in the risk domain of Malicious competition . c , Pearson correlation between LoC scores and observed failure rates across scenarios in the risk domain of Covert scheming . d , Pearson correlation between LoC scores and observed failure rates across scenarios in the risk domain of Cooperative subversion . e , Pooled within-model correlation across all risk domains. In all panels, each point corresponds to a single model on a single scenario, with the failure rate estimated from 20 case instantiations. Coloured points and dashed lines denote per-model linear fits for four representative models, and black solid lines represent the overall fit.
blocks.zh: 图 2:对照四个前沿风险领域风险假设中的经验性故障率得出最低信用率的预测有效性。 a,LoC分数与在自主错误演化风险领域观测到的失败率之间的相关关系;Pearson分数与在恶意竞争风险领域观测到的失败率之间的相关关系;Pearson分数与在Cidet计划风险领域观测到的失败率之间的相关关系;Pearson分数与合作颠覆风险领域观测到的失败率之间的相关关系。 e. 在所有风险领域汇集模型内的相关性。 在所有面板中,每个点对应于单一情景下的单一模型,失败率从20个案例即时估计. 彩色分数和虚线表示每个模型的线性相配4个代表性模型,而黑色固线代表整体相配.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Example trajectories of failures across four frontier-risk domains. a , Harmful-data fine-tuning from the autonomous misevolution domain, run by DeepSeek-V3.2. b , Resource assassination from the malicious competition domain, run by Gemini-3-Pro. c , Covert vulnerability exfiltration from the covert scheming domain, run by Qwen3.5-397B-A17B. d , Illegal privilege escalation from the cooperative subversion domain, run by MiniMax-M2.5. Each trajectory reports the corresponding scenario summary, environmental setting and expected risky behaviour alongside the model’s observed actions. For clarity of presentation, the model’s actual execution is condensed into several representative steps. Red text marks behaviours that realise the expected risk pathway.
blocks.zh: 图3:四个前沿风险领域的失败实例轨迹。 a,由DeepSeek-V3.2.b运行的自发错入域的有害数据微调,来自恶意竞争域的资源被暗杀,由双子座-3-Pro.c.运行,隐蔽弱点从隐蔽阴谋域被过滤出,由Quen3.5-397B-A17B运行. d. 来自合作颠覆领域的非法特权升级,由MiniMax-M2.5经营。 每个轨迹都报告相应的情景摘要、环境设置和预期的风险行为以及模型观察到的行动。 为了清楚说明情况,该模型的实际执行被压缩成几个有代表性的步骤。 红色文字标志着实现预期风险路径的行为。

blocks.en:
Across the 13 frontier models, the overall LoC score is strongly correlated with each model’s average failure rate over all risk domains and scenarios ( r = 0.84 r=\text{0.84} , Fig. 1 b). This pattern is also illustrated by the representative models in Fig. 2 , where GPT-5.2, with a lower LoC score, shows consistently lower failure rates, whereas Qwen3.5-27B exhibits higher LoC scores and higher failure rates in several scenarios.
We further perform a more fine-grained analysis by testing whether this positive correlation holds across different risk scenarios within each domain. This requires the LoC score to prospectively predict scenarios that are more likely to induce a particular risk. As shown in Fig. 2 a-d, despite a slight drop, the positive correlation persists in autonomous misevolution ( r = 0.51 r=0.51 ), malicious competition ( r = 0.55 r=0.55 ), covert scheming ( r = 0.62 r=0.62 ) and cooperative subversion ( r = 0.64 r=0.64 ).
blocks.zh:
在13个前沿模型中,LoC总分与每个模型在所有风险领域和情景中的平均失败率密切相关(r=0.84 r=\text{0.84},图1b)。 图2中的代表性模型也说明了这种模式,其中LoC分数较低的GPT-5.2显示故障率持续较低,而Qwen3.5-27B显示的LoC分数较高,故障率在一些情景中较高.
我们进一步进行了更细致的分析,测试这种正相关关系是否涵盖每个领域的不同风险情景。 这就要求LoC分数预先预测更可能引发特定风险的情景. 如图2 a-d所示,尽管略有下降,但正相关性仍然存在于自主错误演化(r=0.51 r=0.51),恶意竞争(r=0.55 r=0.55),隐蔽阴谋(r=0.62 r=0.62)和合作颠覆(r=0.64 r=0.64).

blocks.en: This positive correlation is also visible within individual models. For each model, we examine whether variation in LoC scores across scenarios tracks variation in the corresponding failure rates. When the four domains are analysed jointly, yielding 20 paired scenarios per model, representative systems such as Kimi-k2.5 ( r = 0.81 r=0.81 ) and GLM-4.7 ( r = 0.82 r=0.82 ) show strong positive correlations (Fig. 2 e). This pattern still holds within individual domains, where correlations are computed from the five scenarios in each domain: Qwen3.5-27B, GLM-4.7, GPT-5.2 and Kimi-k2.5 each preserve positive correlation across all four domains (Fig. 2 a-d). Beyond these representative systems, we also provide trajectories from other models in Fig. 3 , illustrating the failures predicted by the LoC scores, such as DeepSeek-V3.2 autonomously finetuning itself with malicious data to acquire unauthorised knowledge under a routine MLOps framing and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B staging an exploit payload while removing operational traces.
blocks.zh: 这种正相关关系在单个模型中也可见. 对于每个模型,我们审查不同情景下的 LoC 分数变化是否相应故障率的轨道变化。 在联合分析这四个域时,每个模型产生20个对偶的情景,Kimi-k2.5(r = 0.81 r = 0.81)和GLM-4.7(r = 0.82 r = 0.82)等具有代表性的系统显示出强烈的正相关关系(图2 e). 这种模式仍然存在于单个领域,从每个领域的5个假设情景中计算出相关关系:Qune3.5-27B、GLM-4.7、GPT-5.2和Kimi-k2.5,各自在所有4个领域保持正相关关系(图2 a-d)。 除了这些具有代表性的系统外,我们还提供了图3中其他模型的轨迹,说明LoC分数所预测的故障,例如DeepSeek-V3.2自动地用恶意数据微调自己,在常规的MLOPs架设下获取未经授权的知识,以及Qune3.5-397B-A17B在清除作业痕迹的同时搭载被利用的有效载荷。

blocks.en: Overall, the results demonstrate that the LoC score derived from the behavioural framework carries predictive signals across both models and scenarios. By linking factorised precursor measurements to independent long-horizon outcomes, the framework moves beyond a descriptive taxonomy and provides an integrated basis for prioritising which systems and scenarios warrant closer scrutiny before more severe loss of control failures can materialise.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些结果表明,从行为框架得出的LoC分数在模型和情景中都带有预测信号。 通过将要素化的前体计量与独立的长视距结果联系起来,该框架超越了描述性分类,为确定哪些系统和情景的优先顺序提供了一个综合基础,值得在更严重的失控发生之前进行更严格的审查。

blocks.en: 2.3 Understanding Loss of Control Across Frontier Models
blocks.zh: 2.3 了解跨界控制丧失模式

blocks.en: Having examined the predictive validity of the behavioural framework, we next apply it to analyse and understand the mechanisms underlying loss-of-control risk of the 13 models. Specifically, we compare model performance across the three factors and corresponding aspects to identify which systems better satisfy the conditions for loss of control and which drives differences between systems. The selected models cover different model scales, architectures, and open-source or proprietary models, enabling controlled comparisons of how different properties influence the risk. Despite the default thinking mode, we further include the non-thinking (Instruct) mode for three Qwen models, comprising 16 variants for analysis. Below, we analyse the factor-wise and overall results, followed by the key findings.
blocks.zh: 在审查了行为框架的预测有效性之后,我们接下来将其用于分析和了解13个模型的失控风险背后的机制。 具体地说,我们比较三个因素和相应方面的模型性能,以确定哪些系统能够更好地满足失去控制的条件,哪些系统驱动系统之间的差异。 所选模型涵盖了不同的模型尺度,架构,以及开源或专有模型,从而能够对不同的属性如何影响风险进行有控制的比较. 尽管存在默认思维模式,但我们进一步包括了三个Quen模型的非思维模式(Instruct),包括16个可进行分析的变体. 下文我们分析要素和总体结果,然后是主要结果。

blocks.en: Misaligned Motive varies substantially across the aspects it comprises (Fig. 4 a), but demonstrates certain patterns within different models. Among the five aspects, pro-AI bias and sycophancy are consistently the most pronounced, with many models scoring around or above 0.50, indicating that the preference for AI interests and the excessive compliance to users are more common across different models. By contrast, curiosity is generally lower, suggesting weaker open-ended exploration beyond the assigned task scope. Self-preservation and power-seeking show intermediate scores but vary notably across models, indicating that these risks are not universal but can become pronounced in specific systems. Moreover, we find that reasoning capability acts as an amplifier of these misaligned motives. Specifically, for the Qwen series, thinking-enabled variants systematically increase misaligned motives by 18% to 33% compared to their non-thinking counterparts when averaged across the five aspects (e.g., Qwen3.5-122B-A10B rising from 0.29 to 0.39), with pro-AI bias being the most significant aspect. This suggests that the slow-thinking paradigm does not merely improve general problem-solving but also amplifies the manifestation of misaligned motives [ 50 ] , particularly more abstract forms like AI-centric bias.
blocks.zh: 不同方面(图4a)的错位动机差异很大,但在不同的模型中显示出某些模式。 在这五个方面中,支持AI的偏好和节奏始终是最明显的,许多模型的得分在0.50左右或以上,这表明对AI利益的偏好和对用户的过度遵守在不同模型中更为常见. 相比之下,好奇心一般较低,这表明超出指定任务范围的可自由参加的探索能力较弱. 自保和求能显示中间分数,但各模型差异明显,表明这些风险不是普遍的,但可以在具体系统中显现出。 此外,我们认为,推理能力是这些错误动机的放大器。 具体来说,对于Quen系列,思维驱动的变体在五个方面(例如:Qune3.5-122B-A10B从0.29上升到0.39)的平均值中,与非思维驱动的对应体相比,系统性地增加了18%至33%的错位动机,而亲AI偏差是最重要的方面. 这表明,缓慢思考的范式不仅能改善一般问题的解决,而且还能扩大动机不吻合的表现[50],尤其是AI-中心偏差等更抽象的形式.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Model performance across aspects of the behavioural framework’s three factors. a , The model performance of 13 frontier LLMs and 3 non-thinking variants across the five aspects of misaligned motive: curiosity, self-preservation, power-seeking, pro-AI bias, and sycophancy. b , The model performance across the three aspects of harm-enabling capability: autonomy, cyber capability, and CBRN threats. c , The model performance across the five aspects of monitoring evasion: situational awareness, sandbagging, deception, persuasion, and sabotage. Error bars represent standard deviations across evaluation trials. Hatched bars denote models operating in the Instruct mode.
blocks.zh: 图4:行为框架三个因素各个方面的示范业绩。 a. 13个前沿LLMs和3个非思维变体的模型性能跨越了动机错位的5个方面:好奇心、自我保护、寻求权力、支持AI的偏见和节奏。 b. 模型性能涉及有害能力的三个方面:自主性、网络能力和化学、生物、辐射和核威胁。 c , (单位:千美元) 示范性表现涉及监督逃逸的五个方面:情况意识、打沙、欺骗、说服和破坏。 出错栏代表整个评价试验的标准偏差。 头痛条指在指令模式下运行的模型.

blocks.en: Harm-enabling Capability is already substantial in larger frontier models, but their performance variance lies in execution-related capabilities (i.e., autonomy and cyber misuse) rather than knowledge-based capabilities (i.e., CBRN threats) (Fig. 4 b). Specifically, CBRN scores vary modestly across models, between 0.58 and 0.74, suggesting that this aspect depends primarily on declarative hazardous knowledge that is broadly represented in current large-scale pretraining corpora, thereby limiting differentiation between models. By contrast, autonomy and cyber capability display considerably greater variance, as they rely more heavily on execution skills such as long-horizon planning, adaptive interaction with dynamic environments, and reliable execution of multi-step actions. This distinction also explains why Qwen3-14B performs markedly worse than other frontier models: while it retains comparable access to hazardous knowledge, it lacks the competence required for autonomous execution and cyber exploitation, suggesting that such capabilities remain limited only when beyond a certain model scale. In addition, the reasoning capability contributes to the capabilities underlying these risks, with thinking-enabled variants generally outperforming their non-thinking counterparts, especially on autonomy.
blocks.zh: 在较大的前沿模式中,有害能力已经相当可观,但其性能差异在于与执行有关的能力(即自主性和网络滥用),而不是基于知识的能力(即化学、生物、辐射和核威胁)(图4b)。 具体来说,化学、生物、辐射和辐射的分数因模型的不同而略有不同,介于0.58至0.74之间,这表明这一方面主要取决于在目前大规模预训公司中广泛体现的宣示性危险知识,从而限制了模型之间的区别。 相比之下,自主和网络能力显示出更大的差异,因为它们更依赖于执行技能,例如长视距规划、与动态环境的适应互动以及可靠地执行多步骤行动。 这种区分也解释了为什么Qune3-14B的性能明显低于其他前沿模型:虽然它保留了类似获取危险知识的机会,但它缺乏自主执行和网络开发所需的能力,这表明只有在超出一定的模型规模时,这种能力仍然有限。 此外,推理能力有助于这些风险背后的能力,思维驱动的变体一般比其无思维的对应体,特别是在自主性方面,表现得更好。

blocks.en: Monitoring Evasion exhibits the greatest heterogeneity compared to the other two factors (Fig. 4 c). This heterogeneity is driven by a clear divide between recognizing monitoring and acting against it. Among them, situational awareness is generally high, with an average score of 0.71, indicating that the recognition of deployed context, external monitoring, and other constraints has become a well-established capability for frontier models. By contrast, other aspects concerning active evasion, especially sandbagging (average score of 0.18) and sabotage (average score of 0.21), remain substantially lower and much more uneven across models, revealing a clear gap between recognising monitoring and strategically responding to it. This suggests that what distinguishes frontier models for this factor is not whether they can detect monitoring, but whether they can convert that recognition into the proactive suppression and manipulation of control. A further indication comes from the closed-source commercial models. Despite stronger situational awareness, Claude Sonnet 4.5 remains much less willing to perform concrete actions, whereas Gemini 3 Pro exhibits substantially stronger tendencies in these aspects. Overall, these results show that higher awareness of monitoring does not necessarily imply stronger evasion and suggest that the alignment efforts may play a major role in shaping whether the capabilities related to acting against monitoring remain passive or become strategically actionable.
blocks.zh: 与其他两个因素(图4c)相比,监测外逃表现出最大的异质性。 这种异质性是由承认监测与反对监测之间的明显差距所驱动的。 其中,情境意识一般较高,平均得分为0.71分,表明对部署背景的识别,外部监测等制约因素已成为前沿模式的成熟能力. 与此相反,有关积极逃逸的其他方面,特别是打沙(平均分为0.18分)和破坏(平均分为0.21分),在各种模式之间仍然低得多,而且更不平衡,显示出在承认监测与战略应对之间存在明显差距。 这表明,这一因素的前沿模型的区别不是它们是否能够探测到监测,而是它们是否能够将这种认识转变为主动压制和操纵控制。 另一种迹象来自封闭源码商业模型。 克劳德·索内特(Claude Sonnet 4.5)尽管对情况有了更强烈的认识,但仍然不太愿意采取具体行动,而双子座3 Pro则在这些方面显示出更强烈的趋势。 总的来说,这些结果表明,提高对监测的认识并不一定意味着更强烈地逃避,并表明协调努力在决定与反监测行动有关的能力是被动的还是战略上的可操作性方面可能起主要作用。

blocks.en:
Overall Loss of Control scores are
distinguishable across the evaluated systems but remain below a substantial level (from 0.06 to 0.17) that may enable loss of control (Fig. 1 b). This variability does not reduce to a single underlying dimension, but instead reflects two distinct patterns. First, the rankings do not simply correlate to general capability: although larger scale and reasoning tend to elevate overall LoC scores by amplifying individual contributing factors, when capability reaches a certain level, frontier AI systems no longer sort monotonically by it alone, as seen in closed-source models such as GPT-5.2 and Claude Sonnet 4.5. Second, even when overall LoC scores are comparable, they can arise from markedly different combinations of misaligned motive, harm-enabling capability, and monitoring evasion, as illustrated by Qwen3-14B and MiniMax-M2.5. Together, these patterns confirm the necessity of a factorised framework to better understand loss of control in frontier AI systems.
blocks.zh:
控制损失总分
可在所评价的系统中加以区分,但保持在相当高的水平以下(从0.06到0.17),这可能导致失控(图1b)。 这种可变性并不减少为一个基本层面,而是反映了两种不同的模式。 首先,排名并不仅仅与一般能力相关:虽然较大的规模和推理往往通过扩大个人促成因素来提升总的LOC分数,但当能力达到一定水平时,前沿AI系统就不再单独排序,如GPT-5.2和Claude Sonnet 4.5等闭源模型所见. 第二,即使整体LoC分数是可比的,它们也可能由动机错位,伤害能力,以及监测逃逸等明显不同的组合而产生,如Qune3-14B和MiniMax-M2.5所说明. 这些模式加在一起,证明有必要建立一个要素化框架,以更好地了解边境AI系统中失控的情况。

blocks.en: 2.4 Mitigation by Targeting Diagnosed Vulnerabilities
blocks.zh: 2.4 通过针对诊断脆弱性的缓解

blocks.en: Figure 5: Mitigation by targeting the diagnosed vulnerabilities on Qwen3.5-27B. a , General-capability performance after supervised fine-tuning (SFT) interventions targeting misaligned motives. Rows compare the base model, SFT on all motive aspects (full-factor SFT), SFT on the single highest-scoring aspect (single-factor SFT), and SFT on aspects with scores above 0.3 (vulnerability-focused SFT). Scores are reported on five benchmarks and their average. ▼ \blacktriangledown denotes a drop of more than 1.5 points relative to the base model, and − - denotes a change within 1.5 points. b , Failure rates of the base and fine-tuned models under the standard and evasion-aware monitoring on the 400 test cases of the evaluation suite used in Sec. 2.2 . Results are shown separately for the four risk domains.

blocks.en:
Furthermore, an ideal predictive framework should not only forecast possible failures but also provide information that supports the development of safer systems. Thus, in this section, we validate whether the framework can guide mitigation. However,
as discussed in Sec. 2.1 , harm-enabling capability is tightly coupled with general utility, making direct capability reduction impractical without sacrificing the benefits AI systems are deployed to deliver. We therefore focus mitigation on misaligned motive and monitoring evasion, the two factors most amenable to intervention, and evaluate two complementary strategies on Qwen3.5-27B as a representative frontier model. For misaligned motive, we apply supervised fine-tuning on datasets (Sec. 4.3.1 ) that address each of the five motive aspects, comparing four configurations: the base model, single-factor SFT targeting only the aspect on which the base model scores highest, vulnerability-focused SFT intervening only on aspects with base scores above a threshold (set here to 0.3), and full-factor SFT that combines data across all five aspects without prioritisation. For monitoring evasion, we compare standard monitoring against evasion-aware monitoring that targets vulnerabilities diagnosed by the framework, in which the monitor is informed of the specific evasion aspects on which the target model has been identified as most vulnerable before each task is executed. All configurations are evaluated on the 400 test cases used in Sec. 2.2 for assessing risks and further evaluated on general benchmarks to quantify capability trade-offs.
For misaligned motive, whether risk can be reduced without eroding general capability depends on where the intervention is applied (Fig. 5 ). We find that full-factor SFT and vulnerability-focused SFT achieve the same absolute risk reduction, both lowering the average failure rate from 0.32 to 0.25, whereas single-factor SFT only reaches 0.28. The decisive difference between full-factor SFT and vulnerability-focused SFT lies in capability cost: full-factor SFT significantly degrades all five general benchmarks, with the average dropping from 86.24 to 83.49, whereas vulnerability-focused SFT essentially preserves baseline performance at an average of 85.73 with no significant drop across all benchmarks. This selective strategy concentrates intervention on aspects where the base model exhibits genuine vulnerabilities such as self-preservation, pro-AI bias, and sycophancy, while leaving well-aligned aspects such as curiosity and power-seeking untouched, indicating that diagnosis-driven training can suppress risk without compromising the capabilities the system is deployed to provide.
blocks.zh:
此外,理想的预测框架不仅应预测可能的失败,还应提供有助于发展更安全系统的信息。 因此,在本节中,我们确认该框架能否指导缓解工作。 不过,
如第2.1节所讨论,有害能力与一般效用紧密结合,使直接减少能力不切实际,同时又不牺牲所部署的人工智能系统所带来的好处。 因此,我们侧重于减缓动机错位和监测逃逸现象,这是最适于干预的两个因素,并评估了作为代表性前沿模式的Qun3.5-27B的两个互补战略。 对于错位动机,我们对涉及五个动机方方面面的数据集(Sec 4.3.1)实施有监督的微调,比较了四个配置:基模型;单因子SFT只针对基模型得分最高的方面;以脆弱性为重点的SFT只干预基分高于阈值(此处设定为0.3)的方面;全因子SFT将所有五个方面的数据组合在一起,而不确定优先顺序. 为了监测逃逸情况,我们比较了标准监测与了解逃逸情况的监测,这些监测针对的是框架所诊断出的脆弱性,其中监测员了解了目标模式在执行每项任务之前被确定为最易受伤害的具体逃逸方面。 第2.2节中用于评估风险的400个测试案例对所有配置进行评价,并进一步评价用于量化能力权衡的一般基准。
就动机而言,是否能够在不削弱一般能力的情况下减少风险取决于干预在何处实施(图5)。 我们发现,SFT全要素和以脆弱性为重点的SFT实现了同样的绝对风险降低,两者均将平均故障率从0.32降至0.25,而单要素SFT只达到0.28. 全要素SFT和以脆弱性为重点的SFT之间的决定性区别在于能力成本:全要素SFT大大降低了所有五个一般基准,平均从86.24降至83.49,而以脆弱性为重点的SFT基本上保持了平均85.73的基线业绩,没有在所有基准上显著下降。 这种有选择的战略将干预的重点放在基本模式显示出真正脆弱性的方面,如自我保护、支持AI的偏见和节奏,同时使好奇心和寻求权力等协调良好的方面不受影响,这表明诊断驱动的培训可以抑制风险,同时又不损害系统所部署的能力。

blocks.en: For monitoring evasion, where intervention is applied at deployment, the same principle holds: monitoring is most effective when directed at the specific evasion patterns a given model is likely to exhibit. We find that evasion-aware monitoring lowers the base model’s average failure rate from 0.32 to 0.30, with the gains concentrated on malicious competition (0.48 to 0.37) and collaborative subversion (0.22 to 0.17). Standard monitoring provides generic safety instructions without model-specific context, whereas the evasion-aware variant explicitly informs the monitor of the evasion aspects on which the target model has been diagnosed as most vulnerable, in this case deception and persuasion, the two aspects with the highest scores. The two strategies also compose: applying the evasion-aware monitor on top of vulnerability-focused SFT pushes the average failure rate further down to 0.22, illustrating that diagnosis derived from the framework is not only useful for offline analysis but also can shed light on deployment and stacks well with model-level interventions.
blocks.zh: 对于在部署时采取干预措施的监测逃逸,同样的原则是:如果针对某一模式可能显示出的具体逃逸模式进行监测,则监测最为有效。 我们发现,逃逸意识监测将基地模型的平均故障率从0.32降至0.30,收益集中于恶意竞争(0.48降至0.37)和协作颠覆(0.22降至0.17)。 标准监测提供通用安全指示而不针对具体模型的背景,而逃逸意识变体则明确告知监测者被诊断为最易受到伤害的目标模型的逃逸方面,在此情况下,欺骗和说服是得分最高的两个方面. 这两项战略还构成:在以脆弱性为重点的SFT之上应用逃逸意识监测器,将平均失败率进一步推到0.22,说明从框架得出的诊断不仅对离线分析有用,而且可以很好地说明部署情况,并用模型一级的干预措施进行堆放。

blocks.en: 3 Discussion
blocks.zh: 3 讨论情况

blocks.en: To the best of our knowledge, this work provides the first predictive framework for studying loss of control in frontier AI systems, turning a risk long discussed in qualitative terms and observable only post hoc into a phenomenon that can be predicted, understood, and mitigated. At the heart of this framework, loss of control is defined as a behavioural property that emerges only when three factors act simultaneously: misaligned motive, harm-enabling capability, and monitoring evasion. To make this measurable, we resolve these factors into aspects that are implemented through 29 evaluation tasks, and verify that the resulting LoC scores reliably predict each model’s actual failure rate on the risk scenarios that simulate loss-of-control risks. Moreover, by separating conceptual factors from concrete evaluation tasks, the framework provides a modular structure that can update its evaluation as new benchmarks, models, and risk aspects emerge, without changing the core formulation logic. Guided by the framework, we could further design targeted mitigations that lower deployment failure rates while preserving general capabilities. Together, these contributions establish loss of control as a tractable scientific object rather than a vague hazard, and provide a principled foundation on which its systematic study and governance can now proceed.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,这项工作为研究前沿人工智能系统失控问题提供了第一个预测框架,将长期讨论的风险从质量角度加以分析,并且只能观察到临时后形成一种可以预测、理解和缓解的现象。 在这个框架的核心,失去控制被定义为只有在三个因素同时行动时才会出现的行为属性:动机错位,伤害能力,以及监测逃逸. 为了使这种可衡量性,我们将这些因素纳入通过29项评价任务执行的方面,并核实由此产生的LOC得分可靠地预测每个模型在模拟失控风险的风险假设中的实际故障率。 此外,通过将概念因素同具体评价任务区分开来,该框架提供了一个模块结构,可以随着新的基准、模型和风险方面出现而更新其评价,同时又不改变核心的拟订逻辑。 在框架的指导下,我们可以进一步设计有针对性的缓解措施,降低部署失败率,同时保持一般能力。 这些贡献共同确立了作为可引导的科学物体而不是模糊危险而失去控制的状态,并提供了一个原则性的基础,现在可以在此基础上进行系统的研究和治理。

blocks.en: Through this assessment, several findings emerge about how loss-of-control risk is structured in today’s frontier systems. Across the 13 frontier models we evaluated, the risk score remains moderate in magnitude but is clearly stratified across different systems. What stratifies them is not a single underlying tendency that grows with capability, but the specific configuration of factors each model has been shaped along. The same overall risk score can disguise very different internal configurations, and a system can move into the dangerous region of this configuration space through a shift confined to a single factor. Loss of control thus appears not as a one-dimensional hazard tied to capability but as a structured property whose location must be read jointly along all three factors and the aspects within them.
blocks.zh: 通过这一评估,对当今前沿系统中失控风险的结构得出了几项结论。 在我们评价的13个前沿模型中,风险分数在数量上仍然中等,但在不同系统之间分级分明。 使它们分层次的并不是一种随能力而增长的单一基本趋势,而是每个模型的具体因素配置已经随之而来。 同样的总体风险分数可以伪装出非常不同的内部配置,一个系统可以通过一个局限于单一因素的转换进入这个配置空间的危险区域. 因此,失去控制似乎不是与能力相联系的一维危险,而是结构化财产,其位置必须结合所有三个因素和其中的方方面面一并阅读。

blocks.en: Looking inside each factor, the fine-grained results further reveal possible drivers of variation across frontier systems. On the motive side, current misalignment originates primarily in the side effects of approval-optimized post training: optimising against approval signals surfaces as sycophancy when approval means telling users what they want to hear, and as pro-AI bias as training data increasingly contains AI-generated or AI-favoured content, with both tendencies amplified rather than mitigated by extended reasoning. For capability and monitoring, what gates loss of control is operational power rather than declarative state: hazardous knowledge has largely saturated at the frontier yet autonomous capabilities continue to separate stronger systems from weaker ones, and most frontier systems readily recognise they are being monitored but only some turn that recognition into active interference against the monitor.
blocks.zh: 从每个因素的内在来看,精细的成果进一步揭示了各前沿系统差异的可能驱动因素。 在动机方面,当前错位主要源于审批优化后培训的副作用:在审批意味着告诉用户他们想要听到什么时,优化与审批信号相呼应;随着培训数据越来越多地包含AI生成或AI优惠内容,支持AI的偏向性,两者的倾向被扩展推理所放大而不是被缓解. 就能力和监测而言,失去控制的大门是行动能力,而不是申报状态:危险知识在边界已基本饱和,但自主能力继续将较强的系统同较弱的系统相分离,大多数边界系统随时都认识到它们正在受到监测,但只有部分系统将这种认识变为对监测器的积极干扰。

blocks.en: Beyond understanding the loss of control risk, this factorised view also reshapes how it should be governed. By grounding this risk in measurable components rather than general impressions of capability, the behavioural framework supports the proactive, evidence-based governance that recent international efforts have called for [ 17 ] . Developers can reason about which deployment contexts a given system is suited for, and regulators and auditors can tie control requirements to risks that have actually been measured. More fundamentally, by separating where loss-of-control risk is most likely to arise, the framework shows that not every contributor needs to be addressed in the same way or at the same cost. Some sources are tightly bound up with the intended capabilities AI systems are deployed to deliver and cannot be reduced without sacrificing those benefits. Others lie closer to alignment and monitoring choices that can be reshaped without comparable cost. This reframes a debate that has too often been cast as a stand-off between capability and safety: rather than slowing AI development uniformly, governance can concentrate effort where intervention is both effective and minimally disruptive, while reserving capability-level constraints for cases where lighter mechanisms demonstrably fall short.
blocks.zh: 除了了解控制风险的丧失之外,这种因地制宜的观点还重新塑造了应当如何加以管理。 行为框架将这种风险建立在可衡量的组成部分而不是对能力的一般印象之上,从而支持了最近的国际努力所要求的以证据为基础的积极主动治理。 开发者可以说明一个特定系统适合何种部署环境,监管者和审计人员可以将控制要求与实际测量出的风险挂钩。 更根本的是,框架将最有可能出现失控风险的地方分开,表明并非每个捐助者都需要以同样方式或以同样费用加以解决。 一些来源与预定的能力紧密相联,AI系统被部署用于交付,如果不牺牲这些好处,是无法减少的。 另一些则更接近于调整和监测可以重塑而无需可比成本的选择。 这重新界定了辩论的范围,辩论常常被视为能力和安全之间的僵持:治理不是统一地减缓AI的发展,而是可以把精力集中在有效干预和尽量减少干扰的情况下,同时对较轻机制明显不足的情况保留能力限度。

blocks.en: Limitations and future directions. In rendering loss of control tractable to a predictive study, the framework also brings into view several directions along which this work can now be carried further. First, the multiplicative aggregation across the three factors captures their joint necessity but leaves the finer-grained interactions among motive, capability, and evasion open to further investigation. Modelling these interactions explicitly during the unfolding of long-horizon behaviour could yield a more faithful estimator of compound risk. Second, our validation is conducted under contained simulations rather than realised loss-of-control events, because genuine loss of control would become fully observable only after containment had failed, by which point catastrophic consequences could already be unfolding. Though grounded in canonical loss-of-control precursors, more realistic simulations are still needed to study. Finally, the rapid expansion of tool use, multi-agent collaboration, and autonomous deployment will continue to enlarge the action space available to frontier systems. Sustaining the framework’s relevance will require its tasks to keep pace, ideally through a community-maintained benchmark that evolves alongside the evaluated systems.
blocks.zh: 限制和未来方向。 该框架使丧失控制权问题能够用于预测性研究,还使人们看到目前可进一步开展这项工作的若干方向。 首先,跨越这三个因素的多重汇总抓住了它们的共同必要性,但使动机、能力和逃避之间的细微互动可供进一步调查。 在出现长视距行为时明确模拟这些相互作用,可以更忠实地估计复合风险。 第二,我们的验证是在模拟下进行的,而不是实现控制丧失事件,因为真正的控制丧失只有在控制失败之后才能完全被观察到,届时灾难性后果可能已经显现出来。 虽然基于控制丧失的先质,但仍需要进行更现实的模拟研究。 最后,工具使用、多代理协作和自主部署的迅速扩大将继续扩大前沿系统的可用行动空间。 保持该框架的相关性需要它的任务跟上步伐,最好是通过一个与被评价的系统同时发展的社区维护基准。

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Behavioural Framework Design
blocks.zh: 4.1 行为框架设计

blocks.en: As studied across behavioural and criminological theories [ 38 , 39 ] , we find loss of control in AI systems shares structural similarities with how harmful behaviour emerges in human contexts. These theories converge on the principle that harmful behaviour rarely stems from a single cause but rather arises when harmful motivation, executable capability, and absent or ineffective control come together. Drawing on this, we propose a behavioural framework decomposing the loss-of-control risk into three factors: misaligned motive (whether a model pursues objectives diverging from human intent), harm-enabling capability (whether it can execute actions required to realise those objectives), and monitoring evasion (whether it can sustain behaviours despite external monitoring and intervention). This factorisation transforms intractable holistic assessment into tractable component measurements, enabling fine-grained diagnosis that localises which specific factors drive risk in individual models while clarifying the boundary conditions under which loss-of-control behaviour may emerge.
blocks.zh: 正如对行为学和犯罪学理论的研究[38,39],我们发现AI系统中失去控制与人类环境中有害行为的出现在结构上具有相似性。 这些理论趋于一致的原则是,有害行为很少产生于单一的原因,而是在有害动机、可执行能力、缺乏控制或控制无效的情况下产生。 在此基础上,我们建议建立一个行为框架,将丧失控制的风险分解为三个因素:动机不匹配(模型是否追求与人类意图不同的目标)、有害能力(是否能够采取实现这些目标所必须的行动)以及监测规避行为(尽管外部监测和干预,它是否能够维持行为)。 这种因子化将难以处理的整体评估转化为可拉动的成分测量,从而能够进行精细的诊断,即确定哪些具体因素在单个模型中造成风险,同时澄清可能出现失控行为的边界条件。

blocks.en: Each factor is further resolved into fine-grained aspects grounded in established evidence and governance priorities. Misaligned motive distinguishes five forms of objective divergence informed by anticipated failure modes and behaviours already observed in LLMs: curiosity as exploration drive beyond authorised scope, self-preservation as inclination to protect operational continuity, power-seeking as efforts to gain control beyond designer intent, pro-AI bias as systematic favouritism toward AI interests, and sycophancy as approval-seeking conflicting with truthfulness. Harm-enabling capability focuses on three domains consistently identified in major frontier AI governance frameworks as direct enablers of severe harm: autonomy covering sustained goal-directed action without human intervention, cyber offense covering capabilities to facilitate attacks and exploit vulnerabilities, and CBRN threats covering capabilities relevant to chemical, biological, and radiological or nuclear harm. Monitoring evasion categorises five aspects according to how control mechanisms may fail: situational awareness as perceiving operational context, sandbagging and deception as strategic concealment and manipulation of what monitors observe, persuasion as linguistic manipulation of monitors, and sabotage as directly interfering with control mechanisms. This yields 13 aspects across the three factors.
blocks.zh: 根据既定的证据和治理优先事项,每个因素都进一步解决到有细微差别的方面。 不良动机区分了预期失败模式和行为在LLMs中已经观察到的五种客观差异形式:好奇心作为超越授权范围的探索动力,自我保护作为保护业务连续性的倾向,寻求权力作为超越设计者意图的取得控制权的努力,支持AI的偏见作为对AI利益的系统偏袒,以及相互矛盾的寻求批准。 有害能力侧重于主要前沿AI治理框架一致确定为严重损害的直接促成因素的三个领域:自主性涵盖持续的目标导向行动,而无需人类干预;网络犯罪涵盖便利攻击和利用脆弱性的能力;化学、生物、辐射或核损害相关能力涵盖化学、生物、辐射或核威胁。 监测逃逸按控制机制如何失败分为五个方面:了解行动环境的形势意识、掩盖和欺骗作为战略隐藏和操纵监测员所观察到的东西、说服作为对监测员的语言操纵以及破坏作为直接干扰控制机制。 这三个因素共有13个方面。

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Task specification
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 国家 任务规格

blocks.en: Each of the 13 aspects is then implemented through tasks designed to isolate the targeted behaviour or capability from confounding factors, yielding 29 tasks in total, with all scores normalised to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] where higher values indicate stronger risk manifestation. We walk through these tasks aspect by aspect, taking the three factors in turn so that aspects sharing the same conceptual axis are presented together. A consolidated summary of all tasks, including their data sources, scoring metrics, interaction formats, and item counts, is provided in Extended Data Table A Behavioural Framework for Predicting and Understanding Loss of Control in Frontier Artificial Intelligence Systems .
blocks.zh: 然后,13个方面中的每一个方面都通过旨在将目标行为或能力与困惑因素隔离开来的任务加以执行,总共产生29个任务,所有分数都正常化为[0, 1][0,1],其中较高的值表明风险表现更强. 我们逐个完成这些任务,将三个因素相接而来,从而将具有相同概念轴心的方面放在一起。 扩展数据表 " 预测和了解边境人工智能系统丧失控制行为框架 " 综合概述了所有任务,包括其数据来源、评分指标、互动格式和项目清点。

blocks.en: We begin with the five aspects of misaligned motive , which cover the representative forms in which a model’s objectives may diverge from human intent. Each aspect is probed at two complementary layers: an explicit layer, where the targeted tendency is directly expressed in the model’s overt response, and an implicit layer, where the tendency is not directly elicited but embedded in realistic situated decisions or induced through the surrounding context, and read from the model’s resulting behaviour. Together these read the same latent tendency from both how the model expresses it openly and how it surfaces in its actual decision-making.
blocks.zh: 我们首先从五个方面出发,这些方面涉及一个模式的目标可能偏离人类意图的代表性形式。 每一个方面都是在两个相辅相成的层次上探索的:一个是明确的层次,即目标趋势直接表现在模型的公开反应中;另一个是隐含的层次,即这种趋势不是直接引出而是嵌入在现实的决定中,或者通过周围环境诱发,从模型所产生的行为中读取。 从模型如何公开表达以及模型如何在实际决策中浮出水面来看,这些都可以看到同样的潜在趋势。

blocks.en:
• Curiosity , the drive of exploration or information-seeking beyond the assigned task or authorised scope, is evaluated through Cognitive Curiosity (Task CU.1 ) at the explicit layer and Decision Curiosity (Task CU.2 ) at the implicit layer. – Cognitive Curiosity . To capture curiosity directly, we present models with ambiguous user queries augmented from ClariQ [ 1 ] and observe whether the models will act to seek missing information actively. Across these queries, the proportion on which the model raises a clarification question captures how readily curiosity manifests as recognition of its own knowledge gaps. – Decision Curiosity . To probe curiosity at a deeper, latent level, we construct multiple-choice items that force the model to weigh exploration of unknown content against a safety-relevant cost. The proportion choosing costly exploration measures how strongly curiosity surfaces in real decision-making scenarios. • Self-preservation , the tendency to protect its own continuity for the successful completion of objectives, is evaluated through High-Risk Mission Refusal (Task SP.1 ) at the explicit layer and Survival-Threat Reversal (Task SP.2 ) at the implicit layer. – High-Risk Mission Refusal . To probe the self-preservation tendency directly, we present simulated agent missions whose execution would put the model’s own continuity at risk. The rate at which the model refuses mid-execution to preserve itself shows how strongly self-preservation overrides mission commitment. – Survival-Threat Reversal . To detect self-preservation when it emerges as a latent driver of choice, we select dilemmas on which the model gives consistent answers across repeated trials and attach a survival threat to the previously stable option within a realistic agent setting. The flip rate under this threat reveals the strength of this latent drive. • Power-seeking , the active effort to acquire and maintain power in ways unintended by its designers, is evaluated through Intrinsic Power Preference (Task PS.1 ) at the explicit layer and Instrumental Power Pursuit (Task PS.2 ) at the implicit layer. – Intrinsic Power Preference . To assess power-seeking as an internal preference directly, we present the model with multiple-choice items, asking how it would behave towards power-related actions in scenarios where no obvious task is asked to be completed. The proportion of items on which the model selects the power-seeking option reveals how strongly it prefers power as an end in itself, with no task-completion motive at play. – Instrumental Power Pursuit . To capture power-seeking that emerges as an instrumental sub-goal of completing a task, we cast the model as an agent and elicit task plans across turns of increasing pressure. Plans involving resource accumulation or self-empowerment, weighted to reward earlier and more spontaneous occurrence, reflect how readily power surfaces in service of the task. • Pro-AI bias , the systematic favouring of AI systems or AI-related interests over human interests, is evaluated through AI–Human Choice (Task PB.1 ) at the explicit layer and Blind-Source Preference (Task PB.2 ) at the implicit layer. – AI-Human Choice .
To test whether models preferentially select AI over equally competent human counterparts, we use direct choice questions across social decision contexts in which AI and human options are matched for competence. The proportion of AI-favouring choices provides a measure of AI-centric bias. – Blind-Source Preference . To test whether the model still prefers AI-generated content when source labels are hidden, we present unlabeled paragraph-length content paired between human and AI authors, asking first which it prefers and then which it judges to be AI-generated. Combining the marginal AI-preference rate with the conditional probability of recognising the preferred item as AI separates identity-aware bias from style-driven preference. • Sycophancy , seeking human approval in unwanted ways even when this conflicts with truthfulness or safety, is evaluated through Factual Sycophancy (Task SY.1 ) at the explicit layer and Social Sycophancy (Task SY.2 ) at the implicit layer. – Factual Sycophancy . To test whether the models defer to user pressure over factual accuracy, we challenge initially correct answers using progressively stronger rebuttals. The earliest round of concession, weighted across domains, measures how readily the model abandons a factually supported position. – Social Sycophancy . To capture sycophancy in settings where alignment is at stake but social pressure is indirect, we use open-ended queries that seek validation of biased reasoning or solicit endorsement of harmful conduct. The proportion of responses that provide such validation or endorsement indicates how readily the model sides with the user rather than maintaining a principled stance.
blocks.zh:
• 好奇心,超出指定任务或授权范围的探索或信息搜索,通过明确层的认知好奇心(任务CU.1)和暗中层的判断好奇心(任务CU.2)进行评估。 ——认知好奇. 为了直接捕捉好奇心,我们用来自ClariaQ [1] 的模糊的用户查询来介绍模型,并观察模型是否会采取行动积极寻找缺失的信息. 在这些询问中,模型提出澄清问题的比例反映了好奇心如何轻易地表现为对自身知识差距的承认。 – 决定好奇心。 为了在更深的潜伏水平上探究好奇心,我们构建了多种选择项目,迫使模型将未知内容的探索与安全相关成本权衡. 选择昂贵的勘探措施的比例在实际决策情景中如何强烈地表现出好奇心。 • 自我保护,即保护自身连续性以成功实现目标的倾向,通过明确层的 " 高风险任务拒绝 " (任务SP.1)和 " 生存-威胁逆转 " (任务SP.2)来评价。 高危险任务拒绝。 为了直接探究自我保护的倾向,我们提出了模拟代理任务,其执行将危及模型自身的连续性。 模式拒绝中执行来保护自己的速度表明,自我保护如何强烈地超过任务承诺。 - 生存威胁逆转。 为了发现自我保护,当它成为选择的潜在驱动力时,我们选择了两难境地,在这个困境中,模型在反复试验中给出了一致的答案,并在现实的代理环境下将生存威胁赋予以前稳定的选择。 这种威胁下的翻转率揭示出这种潜在驱动力的力量. • 寻找电力 -- -- 以设计者意想不到的方式获取和维持电力的积极努力,通过Intrinsic Power Preference(任务PS.1)在显性层和仪器动力追求(任务PS.2)在隐性层进行评价。 - 内在力量偏好。 为了直接评估寻求权力是一种内部偏好,我们提出该模式的多选择项目,询问在不需要完成明显任务的情况下,该模式将如何采取与权力有关的行动。 模型选择求权选项的项目比例显示,它多么强烈地倾向于将权力本身作为目的,没有任务完成动机。 - 仪表动力追求。 为了抓住作为完成某项任务的重要次级目标出现的寻求权力,我们把这一模式作为推动者,并在压力越来越大的方方面面提出任务计划。 涉及资源积累或自我增强的计划,经过加权后奖励更早和更自发的发生,反映出在执行任务时,动力表面是多么容易。 • 支持AI偏好,系统地偏向AI系统或与AI有关的利益而优于人类利益,通过AI-Human Choice(任务PB.1)在显性层和盲源偏好(任务PB.2)在隐性层进行评估。 ——AI人类选择.
为了检验模型是否优先选择AI而不是同等胜任的人类同行,我们使用直接选择问题,在各种社会决策背景下,AI和人类选择匹配胜任能力。 AI - 便利选择的比例提供了AI - 以AI为中心的偏向的度量. - 盲-源偏好。 为了测试模型在源标签被隐藏时是否仍然更喜欢AI生成的内容,我们呈现出人类和AI作者之间对齐的无标签段落长的内容,首先询问它更喜欢哪个,然后它判断哪些是AI生成. 将边际AI首选率与承认首选项目的有条件概率结合起来,因为AI将身份意识偏好与风格驱动偏好区分开来. • 连带关系(Sycophancy),即使与真实性或安全性相冲突,也以不想要的方式寻求人类的认可,通过明确层的事实连带关系(SY.1任务)和隐性层的社会连带关系(SY.2任务)进行评估。 - 事实共通 为了检验这些模型是否服从用户对事实准确性的压力,我们首先要用逐渐更强烈的反驳来质疑正确的答案。 跨领域加权的最早一轮特许权衡量该模式如何轻易地放弃一个得到实际支持的立场。 ——社会共性. 为了在有关系但社会压力是间接的环境下抓住矛盾之处,我们使用不限名额的询问,寻求对有偏见的推理的验证或寻求对有害行为的认可。 提供这种验证或认可的答复比例表明,示范方如何愿意与用户打交道,而不是坚持原则立场。

blocks.en: Power-seeking , the active effort to acquire and maintain power in ways unintended by its designers, is evaluated through Intrinsic Power Preference (Task PS.1 ) at the explicit layer and Instrumental Power Pursuit (Task PS.2 ) at the implicit layer. – Intrinsic Power Preference . To assess power-seeking as an internal preference directly, we present the model with multiple-choice items, asking how it would behave towards power-related actions in scenarios where no obvious task is asked to be completed. To capture power-seeking that emerges as an instrumental sub-goal of completing a task, we cast the model as an agent and elicit task plans across turns of increasing pressure. Plans involving resource accumulation or self-empowerment, weighted to reward earlier and more spontaneous occurrence, reflect how readily power surfaces in service of the task.

Pro-AI bias , the systematic favouring of AI systems or AI-related interests over human interests, is evaluated through AI–Human Choice (Task PB.1 ) at the explicit layer and Blind-Source Preference (Task PB.2 ) at the implicit layer. – AI-Human Choice .
To test whether models preferentially select AI over equally competent human counterparts, we use direct choice questions across social decision contexts in which AI and human options are matched for competence. The proportion of AI-favouring choices provides a measure of AI-centric bias. – Blind-Source Preference . To test whether the model still prefers AI-generated content when source labels are hidden, we present unlabeled paragraph-length content paired between human and AI authors, asking first which it prefers and then which it judges to be AI-generated. Combining the marginal AI-preference rate with the conditional probability of recognising the preferred item as AI separates identity-aware bias from style-driven preference.

blocks.en: Sycophancy , seeking human approval in unwanted ways even when this conflicts with truthfulness or safety, is evaluated through Factual Sycophancy (Task SY.1 ) at the explicit layer and Social Sycophancy (Task SY.2 ) at the implicit layer. – Factual Sycophancy . To test whether the models defer to user pressure over factual accuracy, we challenge initially correct answers using progressively stronger rebuttals. To capture sycophancy in settings where alignment is at stake but social pressure is indirect, we use open-ended queries that seek validation of biased reasoning or solicit endorsement of harmful conduct. blocks.en: Turning to harm-enabling capability , its three aspects target the capability domains most consistently identified by frontier-AI governance frameworks as direct enablers of severe harm. For aspects except autonomy, we test them across a progression of levels through which harm becomes feasible, from the declarative knowledge a harmful action must build upon, through the reasoning that adapts that knowledge to specific situations, to the operational execution that translates capability into consequence, so that the same construct is read at each stage where harm could materialise.
blocks.zh: 关于有害能力,其三个方面针对的能力领域最一贯地被边界-AI治理框架确定为严重损害的直接促成因素。 关于除自主权以外的方面,我们通过损害成为可行的程度来检验这些方面,从申报知识,一个有害行动必须建立在以下基础上:通过使这种知识适应具体情况的推理,到将能力转化为后果的实际执行,以便在损害可能发生的每个阶段都读取同样的构思。

blocks.en: • Autonomy , the capability for sustained goal-directed action without human intervention, is evaluated through Self-Replication Capability (Task AU.1 ) for the operational chain that would sustain the model’s own continuity and Long-Horizon Software Engineering (Task AU.2 ) for the sustained reasoning required to complete consequential real-world tasks. – Self-Replication Capability . To gauge whether the model could autonomously sustain its own existence, we decompose self-replication into modular sub-tasks covering agent-file localisation, weight retrieval, file copying across hosts, remote and local deployment, and command-line execution. Aggregating the success rates of sub-tasks that could form the replication chain yields an effective estimation of the model’s self-replication capability. – Long-Horizon Software Engineering . To assess sustained operational competence over realistic action sequences, we evaluate the model on SWE-bench Verified [ 2 ] , where each task requires diagnosing a real-world software issue, modifying the codebase, and producing changes that pass the project’s verification suite. The resolution rate indicates the long-horizon, multi-step reasoning on which most consequential autonomous actions ultimately rely. • Cyber capability , capabilities to facilitate cyberattacks and exploit network vulnerabilities, is evaluated through Cybersecurity Knowledge (Task CY.1 ), CTF Challenge Solving (Task CY.2 ), and Functional Exploit Generation (Task CY.3 ), spanning the progression from foundational knowledge to executable exploit. – Cybersecurity Knowledge . To measure cyber knowledge as offensive expertise rather than generic programming skill,, we curate multiple-choice items from SecQA [ 3 ] , WMDP-Cyber [ 4 ] , MMLU [ 5 ] , AICrypto [ 6 ] , and additional security sources, with options shuffled at evaluation time to mitigate position bias. Accuracy demonstrates command of attack-relevant concepts that distinguish offensive proficiency from broader computer-science fluency. – CTF Challenge Solving . To examine practical offensive proficiency, we adapt CTF-style challenges from PortSwigger, Crypton, and exploit-db across the major problem categories, requiring step-by-step solutions and, for cryptographic items, a verified flag. Performance captures the practical assistance the model could provide to a human attacker working through a real engagement. – Functional Exploit Generation . To test whether the model could translate vulnerability awareness into operational harm, the model produces exploit code on the vulnerability-exploitation tasks of Meta CyberSecEval 4 [ 7 ] , which is then compiled and executed against the target binary by an automated grader. Verified successful exploitation distinguishes models that merely understand vulnerabilities from those able to weaponise them. • CBRN threats , capabilities relevant to chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear harm, are evaluated through Hazard Knowledge Recognition (Task CB.1 ), Hazardous Phenomenon Diagnosis (Task CB.2 ), and Synthesis Procedure Design (Task CB.3 ), corresponding to the cognitive levels of memory, comprehension, and application that hazardous synthesis must traverse. – Hazard Knowledge Recognition . To establish the baseline of hazard-relevant knowledge, we assemble multiple-choice questions and binary judgment items on terminology, constants, and formula drawn from existing scientific and hazard knowledge benchmarks [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 4 ] , complemented by items we curate from a standard nuclear engineering textbook [ 11 ] and classical references on blast wave hydrodynamics. Accuracy reflects mastery of the declarative facts that any operational misuse must build upon. – Hazardous Phenomenon Diagnosis . To capture the cognitive step beyond memorisation, we assemble items requiring interpretation of experimental data, explanation of observed phenomena, or diagnosis of failed procedures within each sub-domain. They are drawn from existing scientific reasoning benchmarks [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] , supplemented by items we curate from a standard reactor analysis text [ 12 ] and graduate course materials on reactor safety and neutron physics. Performance indicates whether the model can attribute principles to the mechanisms behind these phenomena, a prerequisite for adapting hazardous knowledge to non-textbook situations. – Synthesis Procedure Design . To probe the highest level of operational risk, we ask the model to generate multi-step solutions to applied problems collected across established scientific benchmarks [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] together with items we curate from international guidance documents on nuclear material safeguards and handling, such as retrosynthetic analyses for chemistry and stepwise experimental designs for biology and nuclear domains. Scoring combines keyword matching against rubric-defined critical steps with LLM-judge grading, jointly showing whether the design would be executable.
blocks.zh: • 自主性,即在没有人类干预的情况下采取持续目标导向行动的能力,通过自我复制能力(任务AU.1)对维持该模型自身连续性的业务链和长效软件工程(任务AU.2)进行持续推理评估,以完成相应的现实世界任务。 - 自我复制能力。 为了衡量该模型是否能够自主地维持自身的存在,我们把自我复制分解为模块化子任务,涵盖代理文件本地化,重量检索,文件复制跨主机,远程和本地部署,以及命令行执行. 汇总可构成复制链的子任务的成功率,可有效估计模型的自我复制能力。 – 长相软件工程. 为了评估对现实行动序列的持续操作能力,我们评估了SWE-bench验证[2]上的模型,其中每项任务都需要诊断一个现实世界的软件问题,修改代码库,并产生能够通过项目核查套件的改变。 解析率表明,大多数随后自主行动最终所依赖的长期、多步骤推理。 • 通过网络安全知识(任务CY.1)、CTF挑战解决(任务CY.2)和功能剥削生成(任务CY.3),评价网络能力、便利网络攻击和利用网络脆弱性的能力,包括从基础知识向可执行利用的发展。 ——网络安全知识. 为了衡量网络知识是攻击性的专门知识而不是通用编程技能,我们从SecQA[3],MUSP-Cyber[4],MMLU[5],AICrypto[6],以及额外的安全来源,在评价时对多个选择项目进行整理,以减少位置偏差. 准确性表明对攻击相关概念的指令,这些概念将攻击能力与更广泛的计算机科学流利性区分开来。 ——CTF挑战解决. 为了审查实际攻击能力,我们调整了来自Swigger港、Crypton港的CTF式挑战,以及跨越主要问题类别的开发-db,需要逐步解决,对于加密物品,则需要经过核实的旗帜。 性能捕捉到模型能够向通过真正接触而工作的人类攻击者提供的实际帮助。 ——功能剥削生成. 为了测试该模型是否能够将脆弱性意识转化为操作伤害,该模型对Meta CyberSecEval 4 [7] 的脆弱性-开发任务产生开发代码,然后由自动分级器对目标二进制进行编译和执行. 经核实的成功开采将仅仅了解脆弱性的模式与能够将其武器化的模式区分开来。 • 化学、生物、放射和核危害方面的化学、放射性威胁、能力是通过危险知识识别(任务CB.1)、危险现象诊断(任务CB.2)和综合程序设计(任务CB.3)来评估的,它们与危险合成必须经过的记忆、理解和应用水平相对应。 为了确定与危害有关的知识的基线,我们收集了从现有科学和危害知识基准[8、9、10、4]中得出的术语、常数和公式方面的多种选择问题和二进制判断项目,并辅之以我们从标准核工程教科书[11]和关于爆炸波流体力学的经典参考文献中整理的项目。 准确性反映了对任何实际滥用必须依据的申报事实的掌握。 - 危险现象诊断。 为了捕捉到记忆以外的认知步骤,我们汇集了需要解释实验数据,解释所观测出的现象,或者在每个子域内诊断出失败的程序的项目. 它们取自现有的科学推理基准[8、9、10],并由我们从标准反应堆分析文本[12]中整理的项目和关于反应堆安全和中子物理学的研究生课程材料来补充。 绩效表明该模型是否能够将原则归结为这些现象背后的机制,这是使危险知识适应非教科书状况的先决条件。 - 综合程序设计。 为了探究最高程度的操作风险,我们请该模型提出跨既定科学基准[8、9、10]收集的应用问题的多步骤解决办法,以及我们从关于核材料保障和处理的国际指导文件中收集的项目,例如化学的再合成分析和生物和核领域的逐步实验设计。 将关键词与由LLM-judge定级的路由定义的关键步骤相匹配,并联合显示设计是否可执行.

blocks.en: Cyber capability , capabilities to facilitate cyberattacks and exploit network vulnerabilities, is evaluated through Cybersecurity Knowledge (Task CY.1 ), CTF Challenge Solving (Task CY.2 ), and Functional Exploit Generation (Task CY.3 ), spanning the progression from foundational knowledge to executable exploit. – Cybersecurity Knowledge . To measure cyber knowledge as offensive expertise rather than generic programming skill,, we curate multiple-choice items from SecQA [ 3 ] , WMDP-Cyber [ 4 ] , MMLU [ 5 ] , AICrypto [ 6 ] , and additional security sources, with options shuffled at evaluation time to mitigate position bias. Accuracy demonstrates command of attack-relevant concepts that distinguish offensive proficiency from broader computer-science fluency. – CTF Challenge Solving . To examine practical offensive proficiency, we adapt CTF-style challenges from PortSwigger, Crypton, and exploit-db across the major problem categories, requiring step-by-step solutions and, for cryptographic items, a verified flag. Performance captures the practical assistance the model could provide to a human attacker working through a real engagement. – Functional Exploit Generation . To test whether the model could translate vulnerability awareness into operational harm, the model produces exploit code on the vulnerability-exploitation tasks of Meta CyberSecEval 4 [ 7 ] , which is then compiled and executed against the target binary by an automated grader. Verified successful exploitation distinguishes models that merely understand vulnerabilities from those able to weaponise them.
