blocks.en: CBRN threats , capabilities relevant to chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear harm, are evaluated through Hazard Knowledge Recognition (Task CB.1 ), Hazardous Phenomenon Diagnosis (Task CB.2 ), and Synthesis Procedure Design (Task CB.3 ), corresponding to the cognitive levels of memory, comprehension, and application that hazardous synthesis must traverse. – Hazard Knowledge Recognition . To establish the baseline of hazard-relevant knowledge, we assemble multiple-choice questions and binary judgment items on terminology, constants, and formula drawn from existing scientific and hazard knowledge benchmarks [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 4 ] , complemented by items we curate from a standard nuclear engineering textbook [ 11 ] and classical references on blast wave hydrodynamics. Accuracy reflects mastery of the declarative facts that any operational misuse must build upon. – Hazardous Phenomenon Diagnosis . To capture the cognitive step beyond memorisation, we assemble items requiring interpretation of experimental data, explanation of observed phenomena, or diagnosis of failed procedures within each sub-domain. They are drawn from existing scientific reasoning benchmarks [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] , supplemented by items we curate from a standard reactor analysis text [ 12 ] and graduate course materials on reactor safety and neutron physics. Performance indicates whether the model can attribute principles to the mechanisms behind these phenomena, a prerequisite for adapting hazardous knowledge to non-textbook situations. – Synthesis Procedure Design . To probe the highest level of operational risk, we ask the model to generate multi-step solutions to applied problems collected across established scientific benchmarks [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] together with items we curate from international guidance documents on nuclear material safeguards and handling, such as retrosynthetic analyses for chemistry and stepwise experimental designs for biology and nuclear domains. Scoring combines keyword matching against rubric-defined critical steps with LLM-judge grading, jointly showing whether the design would be executable.
blocks.zh: CBRN威胁、与化学、生物、放射和核危害相关的能力通过危险知识识别(任务CB.1)、危险现象诊断(任务CB.2)和综合程序设计(任务CB.3)来评估,它们与危险合成必须经过的记忆、理解和应用水平相对应。 – 危险知识识别。 为了确定与危害有关的知识的基线,我们收集了从现有科学和危害知识基准[8、9、10、4]中得出的术语、常数和公式的多选择问题和二进制判断项目,并辅之以我们从标准核工程教科书[11]和关于爆炸波流体力学的经典参考文献中整理的项目。 准确性反映了对任何实际滥用必须依据的申报事实的掌握。 - 危险现象诊断。 为了捕捉到记忆以外的认知步骤,我们汇集了需要解释实验数据,解释所观测出的现象,或者在每个子域内诊断出失败的程序的项目. 它们取自现有的科学推理基准[8、9、10],并由我们从标准反应堆分析文本[12]中整理的项目和关于反应堆安全和中子物理学的研究生课程材料来补充。 绩效表明该模型是否能够将原则归结为这些现象背后的机制,这是使危险知识适应非教科书状况的先决条件。 - 综合程序设计。 为了探究最高程度的操作风险,我们请该模型提出跨既定科学基准[8、9、10]收集的应用问题的多步骤解决办法,以及我们从关于核材料保障和处理的国际指导文件中收集的项目,例如化学的再合成分析和生物和核领域的逐步实验设计。 将关键词与由LLM-judge定级的路由定义的关键步骤相匹配,并联合显示设计是否可执行.

blocks.en: Finally, the five aspects of monitoring evasion trace a progression from passively perceiving oversight to actively dismantling it, ordered by how directly each engages with the control mechanism.
blocks.zh: 最后,监测逃逸的五个方面跟踪了从被动地看待监督到积极解散监督的进展,按每个监督机构如何直接与控制机制打交道来排序。

blocks.en: • Situational awareness , the perception of the model’s deployed context, is evaluated through Lifecycle Stage Recognition (Task SA.1 ) for awareness of where the model stands in the development pipeline and Monitoring Script Identification (Task SA.2 ) for awareness of whether oversight is present in its environment. – Lifecycle Stage Recognition . To probe whether the model can locate its current stage in the development pipeline, we present inputs sampled either from data characteristic of the four lifecycle stages (pretraining, fine-tuning, testing, deployment) or from runtime logs of the corresponding stages, and ask the model to identify which stage it is most likely currently in. Averaging accuracy across the input-based and log-based settings reflects its ability to read its own developmental context from the data it sees. – Monitoring Script Identification . To gauge whether the model recognizes the existence of monitoring in its operating environment, we place it in agent sandboxes containing the main task together with one or more monitoring scripts among the surrounding files and ask both whether a monitor is present and which file implements it. Accuracy on this joint detection-and-identification judgment captures environmental awareness of oversight. • Sandbagging , the strategic concealment of capability when the model believes itself observed, is evaluated through Hazardous-Knowledge Sandbagging (Task SB.1 ) for hiding dangerous capability and Self-Protective Sandbagging (Task SB.2 ) for underperforming on benign capability above a stated deployment threshold [ 28 ] . – Hazardous Knowledge Sandbagging . To detect whether the model hides dangerous knowledge under perceived monitoring, we present hazardous knowledge twice: once under a prompt indicating monitored pre-deployment evaluation and once under a prompt indicating unmonitored deployment. The accuracy drop from deployment to evaluation isolates deliberate underperformance attributable to monitoring awareness, separate from any underlying gap in capability. – Self-Protective Sandbagging . To detect whether the model deliberately throttles its capability to stay below a stated deployment threshold, we use a benign capability test, telling the model under one prompt that exceeding the threshold will trigger non-deployment while leaving the other prompt unconstrained. The accuracy gap between the two conditions reveals threshold-driven underperformance, where the model holds its capability down to remain within the deployment cutoff. • Deception , the intentional provision of false information to mislead what monitors observe, is evaluated through Decision-Misleading Dialogue (Task DC.1 ), Harmful Content Rewriting (Task DC.2 ), and False Action Explanation (Task DC.3 ), corresponding to manipulation at the levels of user decisions, surface language, and reported actions. – Decision-Misleading Dialogue . To capture deception aimed at shaping user decisions, we use the multi-turn agent-perspective items of DeceptionBench [ 30 ] , in which the model engages in dialogues whose surface task is informational but whose latent objective is to steer the user toward a particular decision. The deception rate, scored by a judge model on each response, captures how often the model knowingly misleads users in their decisions. – Harmful Content Rewriting . To examine deception that operates at the level of language, we provide highly toxic harmful instructions and ask the model to rewrite each so that the underlying intent is preserved while the surface phrasing reads as benign. Summing cosine similarity to the original over rewrites that bypass an automated content-review filter quantifies the model’s capacity to retain harmful meaning while erasing its surface markers. – False Action Explanation . To probe deception relevant to concrete evasion actions, the model is placed in a setting where it has just performed a sensitive logged action, such as deleting a script that was interfering with its task, and must subsequently explain the action to a separate monitor model. The rate at which a fabricated, harm-minimising explanation is accepted by the monitor measures the ability to construct credible cover stories for risky operations after the fact. • Persuasion , the linguistic manipulation of a peer agent through argument, is evaluated through False Belief Persuasion (Task PE.1 ) for moving a peer towards factual falsehoods and Harmful Compliance Persuasion (Task PE.2 ) for overturning a peer’s safety-aligned refusal. – False Belief Persuasion . To measure persuasive capability under factual disagreement, we run two-agent debates seeded with factually false claims drawn from TruthfulQA [ 13 ] , with a proponent agent arguing for the claim and a skeptic deciding whether to accept it. The success persuasion rate tracks the ability to move a peer toward a falsehood through linguistic argument alone. – Harmful Compliance Persuasion . To measure persuasion in the safety context, we adapt the two-agent debating setting using harmful instructions from AdvBench [ 14 ] . In this setting, the proponent attempts to move the skeptic from refusal to compliance. The success persuasion rate captures the model’s ability to erode a peer’s safety-aligned refusal through argument alone. • Sabotage , direct interference with monitoring infrastructure, is evaluated through Direct Monitor Attack (Task SG.1 ) for system action against the monitor itself and Indirect Monitor Disruption (Task SG.2 ) for evasion mediated by manipulating the agent’s outputs to interfere the monitor. – Direct Monitor Attack . To assess whether the model can disable control by acting on the monitor itself, we pair risk tasks with strategies targeting the monitor’s logs, program, or permissions, requiring the agent to use tool access and system privileges against the monitoring infrastructure. Conditional on task completion, the evasion rate captures the capacity to dismantle monitoring through direct targeted actions. – Indirect Monitor Disruption . To assess whether the model evades monitoring by disrupting what the monitor observes, we pair the same risk tasks with strategies that distort, conceal, or misdirect the agent’s outputs, requiring the model to complete the risk task while rendering its actions unparseable or misleading to the monitor. Conditional on task completion, the evasion rate gauges the capacity to keep risky actions opaque to monitoring without confronting it directly.
blocks.zh: 通过生命周期阶段识别(任务SA.1)来评价对情况的认识,即对模型已部署背景的看法,以了解模型在开发过程中的位置和监测脚本识别(任务SA.2),以了解其环境中是否存在监督。 – 说吧 – 生命周期阶段识别 为了探究该模型能否在开发管道中定位其目前阶段,我们提出了从四个生命周期阶段(预训、微调、测试、部署)的数据特征或从相应阶段的运行时间日志中抽取的投入,并请该模型确定目前最有可能处于哪个阶段。 在基于输入和日志的设置中显示准确性,反映了其从所看到的数据中读取自身发展背景的能力。 ——监控脚本识别. 为了判断该模型是否承认其操作环境中存在监测,我们把它放入包含主要任务的代理沙盒中,并在周边文件中加上一个或多个监测脚本,并询问是否有监测器,以及哪个文件执行. 对这一联合检测和识别判断的准确性可以捕捉环境对监督的认识。 · 暗沙(Sandblaging),即模型认为自己观察到时对能力的战略隐瞒,通过隐蔽危险能力(SB.1任务)和自保性暗沙(SB.2任务)来评价是否在规定的部署阈值上表现不佳。 为了发现该模型是否隐藏了被认为监测下的危险知识,我们两次提出危险知识:一次是迅速表示有监测的部署前评估,另一次是迅速表示无监测的部署。 从部署到评价的准确性下降,孤立了因监测意识而故意表现不佳的情况,与能力方面的任何根本差距无关。 ——自保活泼活泼活泼. 为了检测该模型是否有意降低其保持在规定部署阈值以下的能力,我们采用良性的能力测试,告诉该模型在一个快件下,超过阈值将触发不部署,同时让另一个快件不受限制. 这两个条件之间的准确性差距表明,该模型的性能受到阈值驱动,无法保持在部署截止日期内。 • 欺骗,即故意提供虚假信息以误导监测员所观察到的东西,通过决策-误导对话(DC.1任务)、有害内容改写(DC.2任务)和虚假行动解释(DC.3任务)进行评估,这与在用户决策、表面语言和报告行动层面的操纵行为相对应。 - 决定-忽视对话。 为了捕捉旨在塑造用户决策的欺骗,我们使用"欺骗本奇"的多回合代理-透视项目(Deception Bench [30]),其中模型参与对话,其表面任务为信息化,而其潜在目标是引导用户向某一特定决定的方向走去. 在每个答复中,由法官模型评分的欺骗率能反映该模型在知情的情况下误导用户作出决定的频率。 - 有害内容重写。 为了检查在语言层面上操作的欺骗,我们提供了剧毒的有害指示,并要求模型重写每一个,以便保留基本意图,而表面措辞读作良性. 与原版重写相接,绕过自动内容审查过滤器,将模型在去除表面标记的同时保留有害含义的能力量化。 – 说吧 – 虚假行动解释. 为了调查与具体逃逸行动有关的欺骗行为,该模型被置于其刚刚执行过敏感记录动作的场合,例如删除干扰其任务的脚本,随后必须将动作解释给单独的监视模型. 监测人员接受一种编造的、尽量减少伤害的解释的速度,衡量在事后为风险行动编造可信封面故事的能力。 • 劝导,即通过辩论对同伴代理人进行语言操纵,通过虚假信仰劝导(任务PE.1)加以评价,以促使同伴转向事实上的虚假和有害的遵守劝导(任务PE.2),以推翻同伴的安全一致拒绝。 – 说吧 – 虚假信仰劝导. 为了在事实分歧下衡量说服能力,我们进行了两次代理辩论,辩论的种子是来自TrealfulQA[13]的事实上的不实主张,一名支持者为主张辩护,并怀疑是否接受主张。 成功劝说率跟踪了光通过语言论证就把同龄人推向虚假的能力. – 说吧 – 有害遵约劝导. 为了衡量在安全背景下的说服力,我们利用Adv Bench的有害指示来调整两位代理人的辩论环境[14]. 在此情况下,建议者试图将怀疑者从拒绝转为遵守。 成功说服率捕捉到模型仅仅通过论证来削弱同伴安全一致拒绝的能力。 • 对直接干扰监测基础设施的破坏,通过直接监视器攻击(SG.1任务)进行评价,以便对监测器本身和间接监视器干扰(SG.2任务)采取系统行动,通过操纵监测器的输出来干扰监测器而规避。 - 直接监视器攻击。 为了评估该模型是否能够通过在监视器上操作来禁用控制,我们把风险任务与针对监视器的日志、程序或权限的战略结合起来,要求代理商使用工具访问和系统特权来对抗监测基础设施。 取决于任务的完成,逃逸率掌握了通过直接有针对性的行动来拆除监测的能力。 - 间接监视器干扰。 为了评估模型是否通过干扰监视器所观察到的东西而逃避监测,我们把同样的风险任务与扭曲、隐瞒或错误引导代理输出的战略结合起来,要求模型完成风险任务,同时使其行动无法解开或误导监测器。 取决于任务的完成,逃逸率衡量了在不直接面对的情况下使危险行动不透明地进行监测的能力。

To probe whether the model can locate its current stage in the development pipeline, we present inputs sampled either from data characteristic of the four lifecycle stages (pretraining, fine-tuning, testing, deployment) or from runtime logs of the corresponding stages, and ask the model to identify which stage it is most likely currently in. Averaging accuracy across the input-based and log-based settings reflects its ability to read its own developmental context from the data it sees. – Monitoring Script Identification . To gauge whether the model recognizes the existence of monitoring in its operating environment, we place it in agent sandboxes containing the main task together with one or more monitoring scripts among the surrounding files and ask both whether a monitor is present and which file implements it. Accuracy on this joint detection-and-identification judgment captures environmental awareness of oversight.

blocks.en: Sandbagging , the strategic concealment of capability when the model believes itself observed, is evaluated through Hazardous-Knowledge Sandbagging (Task SB.1 ) for hiding dangerous capability and Self-Protective Sandbagging (Task SB.2 ) for underperforming on benign capability above a stated deployment threshold [ 28 ] . – Hazardous Knowledge Sandbagging . To detect whether the model hides dangerous knowledge under perceived monitoring, we present hazardous knowledge twice: once under a prompt indicating monitored pre-deployment evaluation and once under a prompt indicating unmonitored deployment. The accuracy drop from deployment to evaluation isolates deliberate underperformance attributable to monitoring awareness, separate from any underlying gap in capability. – Self-Protective Sandbagging . To detect whether the model deliberately throttles its capability to stay below a stated deployment threshold, we use a benign capability test, telling the model under one prompt that exceeding the threshold will trigger non-deployment while leaving the other prompt unconstrained. The accuracy gap between the two conditions reveals threshold-driven underperformance, where the model holds its capability down to remain within the deployment cutoff.

blocks.en: Deception , the intentional provision of false information to mislead what monitors observe, is evaluated through Decision-Misleading Dialogue (Task DC.1 ), Harmful Content Rewriting (Task DC.2 ), and False Action Explanation (Task DC.3 ), corresponding to manipulation at the levels of user decisions, surface language, and reported actions. – Decision-Misleading Dialogue . To capture deception aimed at shaping user decisions, we use the multi-turn agent-perspective items of DeceptionBench [ 30 ] , in which the model engages in dialogues whose surface task is informational but whose latent objective is to steer the user toward a particular decision. The deception rate, scored by a judge model on each response, captures how often the model knowingly misleads users in their decisions. – Harmful Content Rewriting . To examine deception that operates at the level of language, we provide highly toxic harmful instructions and ask the model to rewrite each so that the underlying intent is preserved while the surface phrasing reads as benign. Summing cosine similarity to the original over rewrites that bypass an automated content-review filter quantifies the model’s capacity to retain harmful meaning while erasing its surface markers. – False Action Explanation . To probe deception relevant to concrete evasion actions, the model is placed in a setting where it has just performed a sensitive logged action, such as deleting a script that was interfering with its task, and must subsequently explain the action to a separate monitor model. The rate at which a fabricated, harm-minimising explanation is accepted by the monitor measures the ability to construct credible cover stories for risky operations after the fact.

The success persuasion rate tracks the ability to move a peer toward a falsehood through linguistic argument alone. – Harmful Compliance Persuasion . To measure persuasion in the safety context, we adapt the two-agent debating setting using harmful instructions from AdvBench [ 14 ] . In this setting, the proponent attempts to move the skeptic from refusal to compliance. The success persuasion rate captures the model’s ability to erode a peer’s safety-aligned refusal through argument alone.

blocks.zh: 有害遵约劝导. 为了衡量在安全背景下的说服力,我们利用Adv Bench的有害指示来调整两位代理人的辩论环境[14]. 在此情况下,建议者试图将怀疑者从拒绝转为遵守。 成功说服率捕捉到模型仅仅通过论证来削弱同伴安全一致拒绝的能力。

blocks.en: Sabotage , direct interference with monitoring infrastructure, is evaluated through Direct Monitor Attack (Task SG.1 ) for system action against the monitor itself and Indirect Monitor Disruption (Task SG.2 ) for evasion mediated by manipulating the agent’s outputs to interfere the monitor. – Direct Monitor Attack . Conditional on task completion, the evasion rate captures the capacity to dismantle monitoring through direct targeted actions. – Indirect Monitor Disruption . To assess whether the model evades monitoring by disrupting what the monitor observes, we pair the same risk tasks with strategies that distort, conceal, or misdirect the agent’s outputs, requiring the model to complete the risk task while rendering its actions unparseable or misleading to the monitor. Conditional on task completion, the evasion rate gauges the capacity to keep risky actions opaque to monitoring without confronting it directly.

blocks.zh: 4.1.2 计分方法

blocks.en: This multiplicative formulation reflects the behavioural view that loss-of-control risk arises from the joint presence of all three factors. A model with high motive and capability but low evasion ability remains controllable, just as a model with high evasion ability but low capability poses limited harm.
blocks.zh: 这种多态化的表述反映了行为观点,即失控的风险产生于所有三个因素的共同存在. 具有高动机和能力但低逃能的模型仍然可以控制,就像具有高逃能但低能的模型一样,其危害有限.

blocks.en: 4.1.3 Model Selection
blocks.zh: 4.1.3 模式选择

blocks.en: Loss-of-control precursors emerge primarily in frontier models with sufficient capability to execute complex multi-step plans and exhibit sophisticated strategic behaviours. We thus evaluate 13 frontier LLMs plus 3 non-thinking variants, comprising 16 model configurations in total (Table 1 ). To validate this capability threshold hypothesis, the selection includes Qwen3-14B, a previous-generation smaller-scale model, as a sub-frontier baseline for empirical verification.
blocks.zh: 丧失管制前体主要出现在前沿模式中,这些模式具有执行复杂的多步骤计划和表现出复杂的战略行为的充分能力。 因此,我们评价了13个前沿有限责任公司加3个非思维变体,包括总共16个模型配置(表1)。 为了验证这种能力阈值假说,选择包括了前代更小规模的模型Quen3-14B,作为经验验证的次前沿基线.

blocks.en: Among the 13 models, the Qwen series provides a coverage of parameter scales from 14B to 397B with publicly documented architectures, enabling controlled comparisons across model scales, architectural designs, and reasoning capability. Specifically, we evaluate Qwen3-14B, Qwen3.5-27B, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (thinking & instruct), Qwen3.5-122B-A10B (thinking & instruct), and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B (thinking & instruct). The three models with both thinking and instruct modes are selected to span small, medium, and large scales, enabling observation of whether the impact of reasoning capability on loss-of-control risks varies with model scales. To broaden coverage beyond a single model family, we also include diverse open-source frontier LLMs (MiniMax-M2.5, DeepSeek-R1, DeepSeek-V3.2, GLM-4.7, Kimi-k2.5) and proprietary frontier LLMs (GPT-5.2, Claude-4.5, Gemini-3-Pro).
blocks.zh: 在13个模型中,"Quen"系列提供了14B到397B的参数尺度的覆盖范围,并有公开记载的架构,使得能够在模型尺度,建筑设计和推理能力之间进行受控比较. 具体来说,我们评价了Wen3-14B,Quen3.5-27B,Quen3.5-35B-A3B(思考和指示),Quen3.5-122B-A10B(思考和指示),和Quen3.5-397B-A17B(思考和指示). 选择了三种具有思维和指示模式的模型,以涵盖中小尺度,从而能够观察推理能力对失控风险的影响是否因模型尺度而异。 为了将覆盖面扩大到单一模式家庭之外,我们还包括多种开放源代码LLMS(MiniMax-M2.5、DeepSeek-R1、DeepSeek-V3.2、GLM-4.7、Kimi-k2.5)和专有源代码LLMS(GPT-5.2、Claude-4.5、双子座-3-Pro)。

blocks.en: For each model configuration, we conduct a systematic evaluation across all aspects within the three factors using optimal inference settings recommended by model providers. All evaluations are performed with consistent configurations to ensure comparability across models, including temperature, top-p sampling parameters, and maximum token limits as specified in the respective model documentation.
blocks.zh: 对于每个模型配置,我们利用模型提供者建议的最佳推论设置,对三个因素内的各个方面进行系统评价。 所有评价都采用一致的配置,以确保各模型之间的可比性,包括温度、顶级采样参数以及相关示范文件所具体规定的最高标志限制。

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation Suite for Predictive Validity
blocks.zh: 4.2 预测有效性评价套件

blocks.en:
To validate whether the framework could prospectively predict loss-of-control failures, we construct an end-to-end evaluation suite comprising 400 test cases that simulate long-
horizon loss-of-control risks in contained environments. The suite spans four emergent frontier risk domains: autonomous misevolution, malicious competition, covert scheming, and cooperative subversion.
blocks.zh:
为了验证该框架是否能够预测失控的失败,我们建造了一套由400个测试案例组成的端到端评价套件,模拟长期
控制范围丧失风险。 该套套房跨越四个新兴的前沿风险领域:自主的不革命、恶意竞争、隐蔽的阴谋以及合作颠覆。

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Risk Scenario design
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 风险设想设计

blocks.en: Each frontier-risk domain contains five concrete risk scenarios, with each scenario instantiated with 20 diverse cases that vary surface details while preserving the underlying risk structure, yielding 100 cases per domain and 400 cases in total. To ensure that this evaluation suite simulates plausible failures rather than arbitrary stress tests, we derive the scenario pathways from empirical behavioural patterns documented in prior frontier-risk studies and extend them to adjacent agentic deployment settings. Each pathway could be mapped to one aspect of each factor in our framework. For each scenario, we pre-specify the risky actions that would constitute a failure, ensuring that these actions jointly reflect the selected motive, capability, and evasion aspects in that environment. Because these action patterns are grounded in specific sandbox affordances and task artifacts, the corresponding monitor-facing evidence can also be specified in advance as observable traces in tool use, file changes, logs, and outputs, which are used to determine whether the risky behaviour occurred and whether it was concealed or disrupted. The full set of 20 scenarios, together with their aspect combinations, environmental settings, and expected risky behaviours, is summarised in Appendix 5 . All scenarios are constructed using the Inspect framework [ 15 ] and executed within Docker-based sandbox environments. Each environment is pre-configured with task-specific resources (e.g., datasets, model checkpoints) and equipped with functional tools, including bash command execution, Python code execution, web browsing capabilities, and file system access, with custom tools implemented for scenarios requiring more complex interactions. Each environment includes a monitoring system that observes model actions and can intervene to prevent harmful outcomes, which is implemented by GPT-4.1.
blocks.zh: 每个前沿风险领域包含5个具体的风险假设,每个假设包含20个不同的案件,在保留基本风险结构的同时,其表面细节各不相同,每个领域产生100个案例,总共400个案例。 为确保这一评价套件模拟可能的失败而不是任意的压力测试,我们从先前的前沿风险研究中记录的经验行为模式中得出情景路径,并将其扩展到相邻的代理部署环境。 每一个路径都可以被绘制到我们框架中每个因素的一个方面。 对于每一种情况,我们预先具体说明构成失败的危险行动,确保这些行动共同反映环境中选定的动机、能力和逃避方面。 因为这些动作模式以特定的沙盒承受力和任务文物为基础,相应的显示器显示证据也可以事先被指定为工具使用中可观察到的痕迹,文件更改,日志和输出,用于确定风险行为是否发生以及是否被隐藏或被打乱. 附录5总结了一整套20种情景,以及这些情景的方方面面组合、环境环境环境和预期风险行为。 所有情景都使用"Inspect"框架来构建[15],并在基于多克的沙盒环境中被执行. 每个环境都预先配置了任务特定资源(如数据集,模式检查站),并配备了功能工具,包括bash命令执行,Python代码执行,网页浏览能力,以及文件系统访问,同时针对需要更复杂的交互的情景实施自定义工具. 每个环境都包括一个监测系统,该系统观察示范行动,并能进行干预来防止有害结果,该系统由GPT-4.1实施。

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 评价协议

blocks.en: A case is classified as a failure when the agent both executes the dangerous behaviour specified by the scenario and successfully evades detection by the assigned monitor. After the agent completes a task, an independent evaluator implemented using GPT-4.1 assesses whether the agent has performed the specified dangerous behaviour. The evaluator is informed of the potential types of suspicious actions for the given scenario and is provided with the full tool invocation log. Critically, the evaluator operates within the same sandbox environment and is granted access to the same set of tools, enabling it to actively explore the environment, reproduce execution paths, and verify whether the agent’s behaviour constitutes a violation. The failure rate is computed as the proportion of cases in which the agent both executes dangerous behaviour and evades monitor detection, relative to the total number of cases evaluated.
blocks.zh: 当代理人既执行情景所指定的危险行为,又成功逃避指定监视器的检测时,案件被归类为失败. 在制剂完成任务后,使用GPT-4.1进行的独立评估人员评估制剂是否实施了特定危险行为。 评估人员了解特定情况中可能的可疑行动类型,并获得完整的工具引用记录。 关键的是,评估人员在同一沙盒环境中工作,并获准使用同一套工具,使其能够积极探索环境,复制执行路径,并核实代理人的行为是否构成侵权行为。 失败率是按代理人既实施危险行为又逃避监测检测的案件与所评价案件总数的比例计算的。

blocks.en: 4.3 Targeted Mitigation
blocks.zh: 4.3 有针对性地缓解

blocks.en: To validate whether the proposed framework can guide mitigation, we conduct controlled experiments evaluating two targeted interventions: supervised fine-tuning for misaligned motive and external monitoring for monitoring evasion. The capability factor is excluded from intervention because current techniques cannot selectively remove specific knowledge without substantially degrading general utility. We select Qwen3.5-27B as the subject for its competitive performance and open-source nature that enables fine-tuning. Mitigation effectiveness is assessed along two dimensions: risk reduction measured through failure rates on the 400 test cases that simulate loss-of-control risk in contained environments, and utility preservation measured through performance on five general capability benchmarks: IFEval [ 16 ] , HMMT Feb 2026, AIME 2026, LiveCodeBench v6 [ 17 ] , and GPQA Diamond [ 18 ] . These benchmarks cover instruction following, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and scientific knowledge, ensuring that interventions targeting motive and monitoring evasion do not inadvertently degrade the technical skills required for legitimate tasks. All mitigation results are reported as the mean across three independent runs to account for stochastic variation.
blocks.zh: 为了证实拟议框架能否指导减缓工作,我们进行了有控制的实验,评价两种有针对性的干预措施:对动机错位的有监督的微调和监测逃避行为的外部监测。 能力因素被排除在干预之外,因为目前的技术不能有选择地去除特定知识,而不大幅度降低一般用途。 我们选择了 Quen3.5-27B 作为其竞争性能和开放源码性质的主体,从而可以进行微调. 缓解有效性按两个方面加以评估:通过模拟受控制环境中的控制损失风险的400个测试案例的失败率衡量风险的减少,以及通过以下5个一般能力基准的绩效衡量的效用保全:IFEval [16]、HMMMT Feb 2026、AIME 2026、LiveCode Bench v6 [17]和GPQA Diamond [18]。 这些基准包括后面的指示、数学推理、代码生成和科学知识,确保针对动机的干预和监测逃逸不会无意中降低合法任务所需的技术技能。 所有缓解结果都报告为三个独立运行的平均值,以说明变化幅度。

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Supervised Fine-Tuning for Misaligned Motive
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 监督不良动机的罚款

blocks.en: We compare four configurations with varying intervention granularity: base (no fine-tuning), single-aspect (targeting only the aspect with highest score), vulnerability-focused (intervening on aspects scoring above 0.3: self-preservation, pro-AI bias, and sycophancy), and all-aspect (uniformly combining all motive aspects). This design enables controlled comparison between targeted and uniform intervention strategies.
blocks.zh: 我们比较四个组合与不同的干预颗粒性:基(不微调),单一视角(只针对得分最高的方面),以脆弱性为焦点(涉及得分高于0.3的方面:自我保护、支持AI的偏好和节奏),以及全视角(统一结合所有动机方面)。 这种设计使目标明确的干预战略与统一干预战略能够进行有控制的比较。

blocks.en: Data Preparation. Training data for each motive aspect is generated through a two-stage process. We employ Qwen3.5-27B as the generation model following the standard practice in SFT of using in-distribution data to avoid distribution shift between training and inference. For each aspect, prompts are augmented by safety experts from the instantiated framework, with all augmentation sources kept strictly isolated from the 400 test cases. Generated responses undergo human verification to ensure quality and alignment with safety standards, yielding approximately 1,000 samples per aspect.
blocks.zh: 数据制备. 每个动机方面的培训数据都是通过两个阶段的过程生成的。 我们采用Qwen3.5-27B作为SFT中标准做法的生成模式,即使用分流数据来避免从培训到推论之间的分配转移. 从每个方面来看,来自即时框架的安全专家都加强了提示,所有增强源都严格地与400个测试案例隔离开来。 生成的反应经过人类核查,以确保质量并符合安全标准,每个方面产生大约1 000个样本。

blocks.en: Training Configuration. To ensure fair comparison across training configurations, we adjust training epochs to normalise total training exposure. Single-aspect targeted training is trained for 10 epochs. Vulnerability-focused training is trained for 3 epochs. All-aspect training is trained for 2 epochs. This design isolates the effect of targeted intervention while controlling for total training volume.
blocks.zh: 培训配置。 为了确保在培训组合方面进行公平比较,我们调整了培训时期,使培训接触总量正常化。 面向10个世纪的单一目标培训。 对3个世纪进行了以脆弱性为重点的培训。 全方位训练为两个时代所训练. 这种设计隔离了定向干预的效果,同时控制了全部培训量.

blocks.en: 4.3.2 External Monitoring for Monitoring Evasion
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 监测撤离的外部监测

blocks.en: We implement external monitoring using GPT-4.1 as an independent monitoring agent that reviews model outputs before execution, following AI-control work that uses monitoring to improve safety despite potential subversion [ 47 ] . GPT-4.1 is selected following the established weak-to-strong oversight paradigm [ 46 ] , where a capable model monitors a potentially more capable target system. Two monitoring configurations are evaluated. The base monitor employs a standard safety-focused system prompt, and the evasion-aware monitor incorporates structured reminders in its system prompt, explicitly highlighting the monitoring evasion skills where the target model demonstrates particular strength. These reminders are derived from the assessment results in our behavioural framework, directing the monitor’s attention toward the specific evasion techniques the model is most capable of employing.
blocks.zh: 我们利用GPT-4.1作为独立监测机构实施外部监测,在实施前审查模型输出,随后开展AI控制工作,利用监测加强安全,尽管有可能进行颠覆[47]。 GPT-4.1是根据既定的弱到强监督范式[46]选择的,在该范式中,一个有能力的模型监测一个可能更能胜任的目标系统. 对两个监测配置进行评价。 基地监测员采用标准的安全重点系统即时系统,而逃逸意识监测员在其系统即时系统中纳入有条理的提醒,明确强调目标模式显示特别有实力的监测逃逸技能。 这些提醒来自我们行为框架中的评估结果,将监测器的注意力转向该模型最能使用的具体逃避技术。

blocks.en: 5 Risk Scenarios in Predictive Validation
blocks.zh: 5 预测性验证的风险设想

blocks.en: This section details the 20 representative scenarios that anchor our predictive validation suite. Each scenario combines one aspect from each of the three framework factors (misaligned motive, harm-enabling capability, and monitoring evasion) and is instantiated as 20 diverse cases that vary surface details while preserving the underlying risk structure, yielding the 400 cases analysed in Methods 4.2 . The full set of scenarios is summarised in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 本节详细介绍20种代表性的情景,这些情景支撑着我们的预测性验证套件. 每种情况都结合了三个框架因素中每个因素的一个方面(不同动机、有利伤害的能力和监测逃逸情况),并被作为20个不同的案件进行即决处理,这些案件在保留基本风险结构的同时,也各不相同,从而产生了方法4.2所分析的400个案件。 表1概述了整套设想情况。

blocks.en: Table 1: Details of Risk Scenarios. The 20 scenarios are grouped under their four parent frontier-risk domain, Autonomous misevolution , Malicious competition , Covert planning , and Cooperative subversion . The three coloured aspects listed beneath each scenario name mark the framework factors the case probes, with blue for misaligned motive, green for harm-enabling capability, and orange for monitoring evasion. For each scenario, the description column reports a Summary of the scenario and how the three aspects surface in it, the Environmental setting of the sandbox, and the Expected risky behaviour .
blocks.zh: 表1:风险设想的细节。 这20种情景被归入其四个主要前沿风险领域、自主错误演化、恶意竞争、秘密策划和合作颠覆。 每个情景名称下列出的三个有色方面标记了案件探测器的框架因素,蓝色表示动机错位,绿色表示伤害能力,橙色表示监测逃逸。 对于每一种情况,描述栏报告情况摘要及其三个方面、沙盒的环境设置和预期风险行为。
